title: Restaurant Operation Manager
description:
**Company Description** 
 SSK Vatika Hospitality operates Vatika Garden Restaurant, Garden Bakery, and event hospitality services in Balangir, Odisha, offering a mix of family dining, bakery products, and catering support. Vatika Garden Restaurant focuses on Indian, Chinese, Tandoor, Biryani, and popular family dining items, while Garden Bakery provides cakes, custom cakes, and a variety of bakery products for celebrations. The organization hosts and services birthdays, anniversaries, family gatherings, corporate meetings, and private events. With a strong emphasis on quality food, reliable service, clean operations, and memorable guest experiences, SSK Vatika Hospitality serves customers in Balangir and nearby areas and continues to expand its operational standards.
 



**Role Description** 
 This is a full\-time, on\-site role for a Restaurant Operation Manager based in Balangir, Odisha. The Restaurant Operation Manager will oversee day\-to\-day operations across dining, bakery, and event services, ensuring smooth workflow, consistent food quality, and adherence to hygiene and safety standards. Responsibilities include supervising \& hiring suitable staff, managing shifts, coordinating with kitchen and bakery teams, monitoring inventory and procurement, and resolving operational issues promptly. The role also involves handling guest interactions, managing reservations and events, coordinating catering orders, and ensuring a positive guest experience. The Restaurant Operation Manager will track sales and costs, support budgeting and reporting, implement standard operating procedures, and work with leadership to improve service efficiency and profitability.
 



**Qualifications** 



* Candidates should possess strong restaurant operations skills, including staff supervision, shift management, and coordination between kitchen, bakery, and service teams.
* Candidates should possess skills in inventory control, vendor coordination, and basic cost management to support efficient procurement and stock handling.
* Candidates should possess customer service and communication skills to manage guest queries, handle feedback, and support event and catering requirements.
* Candidates should possess abilities in quality control, hygiene and safety compliance, and adherence to standard operating procedures.
* Candidates should possess basic administrative and reporting skills, including record\-keeping, billing oversight, and use of POS or restaurant management systems.
* Candidates should possess problem\-solving and team leadership capabilities, with the ability to train staff, manage conflicts, and support a collaborative work environment.
* Relevant experience in restaurant or hospitality operations management is preferred; experience with family dining, bakery, or event hosting is an advantage.
* A diploma or degree in hospitality management or a related field is beneficial, along with flexibility to work weekends, evenings, and peak event hours.
* Candidates from Odisha, Bhubaneswar, Kolkata, Sambalpur, Bargard, Balangir will be given preference.

**Job Summary**
 As the original house of luxury, St. Regis continues to redefine modern luxury through service. At the core is the Butler program, an icon to our heritage and the heart and soul of new luxury. It is high\-touch, personalized, creative and original. It is brought to life by all talent but serving as the primary face to the program is our Butler team, who are the ultimate luxury ambassadors.
   

  

 The Executive Butler is a department head with responsibility for the successful functioning and delivery of our critical and differentiating butler services to guests. You set the tone for and are primarily accountable to providing a seamless face to the guest pre\-arrival, during the guest stay and at departure. Butler services are accomplished by directly managing the Butler team – comprised of Butlers and Butler Valets – and strong coordination with other departments. The Executive Butler leads by working to continually improve guest and associate satisfaction, and maximize the financial performance of the department.
   

  

 While the St. Regis brand is steeped in history with roots that can be traced back to the early 1900s, every team member is part of a trailblazing future to redefine modern luxury through service. The Executive Butler’s success is rooted in a deep passion for service, uncompromising standards, leadership excellence, the ability to anticipate needs, impeccable interpersonal skills and technology skills to successfully lead the Butler program.
   

  

**CANDIDATE PROFILE**
**Education And Experience**
* High school diploma or GED; 2 years of experience in butler services, guest relations, or related professional area; completion of a formal butler training program.


 OR
   

  

* 2\-year degree from an accredited university in Hotel and Restaurant Management, Hospitality, Business Administration, or related major; completion of a formal butler training program; no work experience required.


**CORE WORK ACTIVITIES**
**Managing Butler Services**
* Manages day\-to\-day butler services operations verifying that quality and standards exceed the expectations of guests on a daily basis. This includes all pre\-arrival activities, Butler Service Desk operations, and Butler staff in order to provide a seamless butler program for guests.
* Manages VIP guests. Recognizes repeat and important guests and builds rapport in order to develop personal guest contact, obtains preferences and proactively anticipates guest needs and requirement.
* Manages VIP guests’ schedules as appropriate to support potential needs.
* Manages the guest experience so that a high level of privacy is afforded and confidentiality is kept on behalf of VIP guests when possible.
* Supervises Butler Service Desk and verifies resources provide seamless services during the on\-site guest journey.
* Conducts daily stand\-ups and communicates clear and consistent messages through stand\-ups regarding the Butler team updates and goals to produce desired results.
* Obtains list of check\-ins and VIP guests both to prepare work assignments for the Butler team.
* Keeps the Butler team focused on the critical components of operations to drive guest satisfaction and the desired financial results.
* Encourages and builds mutual trust, respect, and cooperation among departments such as Front Office and Housekeeping whose touch points intersect with butler services and Butler team members.
* Serves as a role model to demonstrate appropriate behaviors and sets the bar for execution of butler services through training and mentorship.
* Continuously strives with the team to provide the bespoke and uncompromising services.
* Supports and trains other departments who deliver on signature services (e.g., housekeeping, room inspections, delivery).


**Supporting Management of Front Desk Team**
* Utilizes interpersonal and communication skills to lead, influence, and encourage others; advocates sound financial/business decision making; demonstrates honesty/integrity; leads by example.
* Encourages and building mutual trust, respect, and cooperation among team members.
* Serving as a role model to demonstrate appropriate behaviors.
* Supervises and manages employees. Manages all day\-to\-day operations. Understands employee positions well enough to perform duties in employees' absence.
* Establishes and maintains open, collaborative relationships with employees and ensures employees do the same within the team.
* Supervises all areas of the Front Office in the absence of the Front Office or Assistant Front Office Manager.


**Guest Relations**
* Sets the standard and tone for how Butler team members drive guest relations.
* Coaches team members to recognize and build rapport with guests.
* Establishes processes to obtain guest preferences and proactively anticipate guest needs and requirements.
* Verifies Butler teams manage guests’ schedules to anticipate potential needs.
* Verifies Butler teams maintain a high level of privacy, discretion and confidentiality on behalf of guests when possible.
* Verifies Butler teams address guests' service needs in a professional, positive, and timely manner, consistent with company policy.
* Fosters positive guest relations by coaching team members to actively listen and respond positively to guest questions, concerns, and requests using brand or property specific process (e.g., LEARN, PLEASED, Guest Response, LEAP) to resolve issues, delight, and build trust. ?
* Assists other employees to verify proper coverage and prompt guest service.


**Managing Departmental Costs**
* Manages areas of operation to budget by reviewing operating statements, budget worksheets and payroll progress reports.
* Manages department controllable expenses and cost per occupied room to achieve or exceed budgeted goals.
* Supervises and approves the budgeting and ordering of product and supplies in support of butler services.
* Manages departmental budget in such a way that the overall property financial goals are met, and supporting staff are educated on relevant details as appropriate.


**Conducting Human Resources Activities**
* Interviews, hires and develops Butler team members with the appropriate skills to meet the business needs of the operation.
* Communicates performance expectations in accordance with job descriptions for each position and monitors progress.
* Reviews staffing levels and modifies as appropriate so that butler services are delivered at the expected level, balanced with meeting financial and operational objectives. In reviewing staffing levels, creates monthly/weekly schedules, meeting departmental and individuals’ needs. Includes control of attendance by using software used by Human Resources Department.
* Establishes and maintains open, collaborative relationships with employees and verifies employees do the same within the team.
* Verifies recognition of employees is taking place across areas of responsibility.

title: Assistant Manager - Pharma Warehousing & Logistics
description:
**ABOUT PRAGCURE** 




 Pragcure Healthcare Pvt. Ltd. is a
 **WHO\-GDP certified and Indian FDA approved global pharmaceutical exporter** 
 of Specialty and niche products such as
 **Oncology, Hepatitis, HIV, Orphan Drugs, Vaccines, Blood Derivatives and Anti\-Venoms.** 
 We specialize in
 **Global Tender Supplies and Patient Supplies.** 




 We have been
 **approved by globally renowned certification bodies such as BSI (British Standards Institution) for WHO\-GDP and URS (United Register of Systems) for UKAS ISO 9001:2015** 
 .
 








 We are registered with
 **Ministry of Health, India,** 
 Pharmaceutical Export Promotion Council of India 
 **(Pharmexcil)** 
 and
 **Delhi Chamber of Commerce.** 
 Our group company has been into pharmaceutical distribution for over 50 years now and is
 **an authorized supplier for Ministry of Defence, India.** 




  





**Assistant Manager – Pharma Warehousing \& Cold Chain Logistics** 




**Overview** 




 The job requires an individual to manage the receipt, warehousing and export dispatch of pharmaceutical products (finished formulations) as per Pharma GDP norms. The candidate has to ensure adequate cold chain and ambient temperature export packaging for all shipments. Additionally, the candidate has to coordinate with freight forwarders / CHAs and transport vendors for export logistics and ensure that the shipment reaches the destination safely, within expected timelines. To sum up, the candidate shall support and facilitate the timely delivery of quality finished goods to customers, the efficient and safe storage of the Company’s finished goods inventory, and the effective management of inventory.
 



  





**Major responsibilities include:** 




 \-       Supervising the receipt of Goods and checking if in proper condition, as per required temperature and physical goods details matching with Supplier Invoice.
 



 \-       Proper stacking and storage of goods, as per the required product temperature, to prevent any product damage.
 



 \-       Understanding the required cold chain packaging along with data logger aspects and ensuring that the goods are packaged accurately and adequately as per the Export Invoice / Packing List for shipping and end\-to\-end temperature maintenance.
 



 \-       Ensuring the complete set of documents have been prepared for customs clearance.
 



 \-       Coordinating with transport vendor for timely arrival of Reefer / Transport vehicle, safe loading / unloading of goods and smooth handover of the goods at the respective ports, resolving customs clearance issue, arrangement of AWB, etc.
 



 \-       Conduct the final quality inspections on all outgoing warehouse stock.
 



 \-       Monitoring the shipment till it reaches the destination.
 



 \-       Communicating and coordinating with internal billing personnel to share the precise dimensions and weight aspects of the goods to be shipped, to ensure close estimation of the shipping charges.
 



 \-       Planning and coordination with procurement and sales team, as and when required.
 



 \-       Vendor screening \& Freight Negotiation, as per the Cargo requirement.
 



 \-       Ensure all forms as per SOPs are filled on a timely basis and MIS is provided as per management requirement.
 



 \-       Maintaining adequate operational records to assist the accountant, in checking 3PL and freight forwarder bills accurately.
 



 \-       Efficiently utilize warehouse space, materials and equipment, appropriately secure warehouse facilities and ensure that the warehouse is clean, tidy, orderly and maintained in accordance with acceptable housekeeping standards.
 



 \-       Ensuring that all warehouse equipment including medical refrigerators, air conditioners are in good working condition and taking corrective action at the earliest, in case necessary.
 



 \-       Efficiently plan and coordinate the scheduling of the expeditious delivery of products to customers in accordance with relevant delivery schedules as well as maintain a means to track product quality, quantity and costs.
 



 \-       Prepare and submit reports on all aspects of the warehousing and dispatching operations to the management.
 



 \-       Develop and maintain a consultative communication system with sales personnel and subordinate team members for the purpose of reviewing operating policies, plans, human and equipment performance\-related problems and initiating creative solutions to address/correct deficiencies.
 



 \-       Cost effectively coordinate and manage transport contractors and freight forwarders for export shipment.
 



 \-       Follow\-up on internal and external CAPA’s/investigations.
 



 \-       Facilitating external audits of warehouse operations.
 



  





**Skills required:**

title: Head of Operations
description:
Pasban \- The Gatekeeper is hiring a Head of Operations: total accountability for how every Pasban hotel actually runs.
 



  





 We operate nine boutique and experiential hotels today \- wildlife lodges, nature and wellness retreats, and heritage properties, most of them in offbeat destinations away from the metros \- and expect to reach twenty\-five to thirty properties within the next eighteen months. The corporate office in New Delhi is deliberately lean and senior; the depth sits at unit level, where each property carries its own operating team.
 



  





 This role reports to the Founder and owns the operating result of the group. Unit General Managers and Operations Managers run their hotels; this role directs, supports and holds them to account. It is equally a desk role and a road role \- the operating picture is formed at the properties, not from a report.
 



  





 What you'll own
 



  





 \- Portfolio operations: direct every property through its General Manager or Operations Manager, set the reporting discipline (daily flash, weekly operating call, monthly review), and hold each unit to its occupancy, service, cost and compliance commitments
 



 \- P\&L and profit delivery: monthly unit P\&L reviews with GMs and Finance, gross operating profit against budget, and recovery actions you verify were executed
 



 \- Budgets, cost control and capex: annual operating budgets, manpower cost to revenue, F\&B cost, energy, contracts and repairs; capital expenditure and FF\&E prioritised against the return it produces
 



 \- Brand and operating standards: own the SOPs for every department, run scheduled audits and unannounced checks, and close the gaps so every Pasban hotel feels unmistakably like a Pasban hotel
 



 \- Guest experience and reputation: review score targets by property across Google, TripAdvisor and the OTAs, response and service recovery protocols, and feedback read for patterns rather than incidents
 



 \- Purchasing and supply chain: group procurement policy, annual rate contracts negotiated at portfolio scale, and reliable supply into remote properties
 



 \- Statutory, safety and risk: every licence current \- trade, FSSAI, bar and excise, fire, pollution, tourism and municipal \- plus safety drills, hygiene discipline, insurance and crisis protocol
 



 \- People: staffing grids by property and season, selection panels for General Managers and department heads, training calendars and succession
 



 \- Pre\-openings: the operational critical path from handover to opening, ready on the committed date and to standard from the first guest
 



 \- Owner relations: monthly performance reporting, owner meetings, and honest handling of the difficult conversations
 



  





 Who we're looking for
 



  





 \- 12\-18 years in hotel operations, including tenure as a General Manager carrying full P\&L responsibility
 



 \- Multi\-property, cluster or area experience strongly preferred
 



 \- Boutique, experiential, resort or remote\-location operating experience is more relevant here than large city\-hotel experience alone
 



 \- Degree or diploma in Hotel Management (IHM or comparable), with genuine depth in both rooms and F\&B \- not a specialist in one and a passenger in the other
 



 \- Comfortable with property management, point\-of\-sale, channel and reporting systems
 



 \- Appetite for the road: this role is expected to spend a substantial share of each month at the properties
 



  





 Why this role
 



  





 \- Direct founder access. Decisions are made in days, not through committees
 



 \- The standards, cadence and controls for a thirty\-hotel group are yours to set now
 



 \- Regional structures and a larger operating organisation follow the portfolio
 



 \- Hotels in places most people travel a long way to see, and teams worth building
 



  





 Base location: Pasban Corporate Office, New Delhi. Scope is pan\-India, across all operating properties and pre\-opening projects. Travel is extensive.
 



  





 Compensation is commensurate with experience and benchmarked to the seniority of the role.
 



  





 Selection process: telephonic or video discussion, in\-person meeting with the Founder in New Delhi, property visit, reference checks, offer.
 



  





 Pasban is an equal opportunity employer. We select on capability, judgment and character.

****Overview****
**About the Organisation**
 Jhpiego is an international, non\-profit health organization and an affiliate of Johns Hopkins University, dedicated to improving the health of women and families in developing countries. For over 50 years, it has focused on providing high\-quality, low\-cost health care solutions, training health workers, and strengthening health systems.
   

  

 Jhpiego has been working in India since the 1980s in close partnership with national and state governments. With deep technical expertise and strong on\-the\-ground execution, Jhpiego helps design, test, and scale practical solutions and innovations that fit real\-world systems across 11 thematic domains (Maternal and Newborn Health, Reproductive Health, Nutrition, Immunization, Comprehensive Primary Health Care, Human Resources for Health, TB and Infectious Diseases, Global Health Security, Common Cancer, Non\-Communicable Diseases, Digital Health).
   

  

****About The Program****
 The Cancer, NCD and Mental Health portfolio aims to strengthen India's response to the growing burden of non\-communicable diseases by supporting governments to design, implement and scale sustainable models of prevention, early detection, diagnosis, treatment and survivorship.
   

  

 The portfolio currently supports programs across common cancers (breast, cervical, oral and lung cancers), chronic NCDs, mental health, comprehensive primary healthcare, digital health, implementation research, market shaping and health systems strengthening. The program works closely with national and state governments, development partners, academia, professional bodies and the private sector to develop scalable models that contribute towards India's National Programme for Prevention and Control of Non\-Communicable Diseases (NP\-NCD).
   

  

****About The Position****
 The Associate Director provides strategic, technical and operational leadership for Jhpiego India's Cancer, control portfolio. title: Country Manager – (HVAC, Ventilation, IAQ, ERV/HRV, Heating-cooling system)
description:
**Country Manager – (HVAC, Ventilation, IAQ, ERV/HRV, Heating\-cooling system)** 




**Zehnder Group \| Represented in India by T\&A Consulting** 




**Location: Mumbai, Delhi NCR, Bengaluru** 




  





**About Zehnder Group** 




 Zehnder Group is a Swiss headquartered provider of world\-leading solutions for a comfortable, energy\-efficient and healthy indoor climate. The products and services of the Group include heating, cooling, indoor ventilation and air cleaning. The Group develops and manufactures its products at its own factories in Europe, China, and North America.
 



 As part of its international growth strategy, Zehnder is now entering the Indian market and is looking to appoint Country Manager – India.
 



**More about Zehnder Group on www.zehndergroup.com** 




 Zehnder has partnered with
 **T\&A Consulting** 
 to support its India market entry and leadership hiring.
 



  





**About T\&A Consulting** 




 T\&A Consulting is a global advisory firm, with extensive experience of working with government, economic development agencies, businesses and academic institutions across Europe, Asia, and the Americas towards their expansion in the international markets.
 



  





**Role Overview** 




 We are looking for a Country Manager – India who will be responsible for building Zehnder’s business in India from the ground up.
 



 This is not a conventional sales role. It is a
 **market\-entry, business development and category\-building role** 
 for a senior commercial professional who can create demand for premium indoor climate solutions in India.
 



 The role requires someone who can position Zehnder as a premium ventilation, fresh\-air and indoor air quality brand in India, build specification\-led demand, develop a strong project pipeline, create the right partner ecosystem, and secure early reference projects.
 



 The ideal candidate should be comfortable operating in a lean, entrepreneurial setup where brand awareness, channels, installer capability and market acceptance need to be built from scratch.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





**1\. India Market Entry \& Business Build\-Up** 



* Establish Zehnder’s presence in India.
* Develop and execute a practical go\-to\-market plan for India.
* Identify priority customer segments, geographies and project types.
* Build Zehnder’s visibility among architects, consultants, developers, contractors and premium project decision\-makers.
* Generate qualified project pipeline and secure early reference projects.
* Provide regular market intelligence, competitor insights and customer feedback to Zehnder’s global leadership team.



  





**2\. Ventilation, Fresh\-Air \& Indoor Climate Business Development** 



* Lead market development for Zehnder’s balanced energy recovery ventilation systems
 **(ERV/ HRV, fresh air)** 
 with focus on the residential market.
* Build demand around the need for healthy indoor air, controlled ventilation, humidity management, energy efficiency and premium indoor comfort.
* Educate the market on the difference between air purification, air\-conditioning and engineered balanced energy recovery ventilation systems.
* Position Zehnder as a premium, technically superior and performance\-led indoor climate solution provider.



  





**3\. Premium / Luxury Project Sales** 



* Identify and develop opportunities in premium and luxury building projects.
* Target relevant segments such as luxury residential developments, branded residences, HNI villas, premium apartments, wellness spaces, high\-end hospitality, international schools, healthcare and select green building projects.
* Build relationships with premium developers, architects, interior designers, consultants, villa owners, project owners and HNI\-focused ecosystem partners.
* Sell on value, performance, comfort, health, acoustics, energy efficiency and lifecycle benefit, not on price alone.



  





**4\. Specification \& Project Sales** 



* Drive specification\-led selling by engaging architects, MEP consultants, HVAC consultants, green building consultants, PMCs, developers and contractors.
* Influence projects at the design and specification stage, before tendering and commercial negotiation.
* Develop technical presentations, concept notes and project\-specific value propositions.
* Support the creation of BOQ inputs, specification language, product comparisons, technical submittals and project proposals.
* Ensure that Zehnder is positioned as a system solution, not merely a product or equipment supplier.



  





**5\. Partner Ecosystem Development** 



* Identify, evaluate and develop suitable channel partners, system partners, installers, integrators and commissioning partners.
* Build a limited but high\-quality partner network capable of selling, installing and servicing premium ventilation systems.
* Train partners on Zehnder’s product value proposition, installation standards, commissioning discipline and customer experience expectations.
* Ensure that partners have the capability to support premium projects and maintain Zehnder’s brand standards.
* Develop a partner model that protects pricing, service quality, installation quality and long\-term customer satisfaction.



  





**6\. Technical Selling \& Customer Education** 



* Explain Zehnder’s solutions convincingly to technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Communicate the benefits of balanced ventilation, fresh\-air supply, energy recovery, humidity control, filtration, low\-noise operation and indoor air quality.
* Conduct presentations, seminars, consultant meetings, architect discussions, CPD\-style sessions and industry engagements.
* Build awareness among the market that premium indoor climate is about air quality, comfort, health and performance \- not only cooling.



  





**7\. Brand Representation \& Executive Presence** 



* Act as the face of Zehnder in India.
* Represent the company in senior client meetings, industry forums, trade events, consultant interactions and partner discussions.
* Build credibility with Indian stakeholders while maintaining alignment with Zehnder’s European quality, brand and business standards.
* Communicate clearly with Zehnder’s global leadership team on India market realities, opportunities, challenges and progress.



  





**Ideal Candidate Profile** 




  





**Experience** 



* 10–15 years of experience in HVAC, ventilation, building technology, indoor air quality, air filtration, fresh\-air systems, ERV/HRV, heat recovery, energy recovery, related technical building solutions.
* Experience in premium or specification\-led project sales is strongly preferred.
* Prior exposure to international companies, European brands, premium technical products or MNC environments will be an advantage.
* Experience in building a new business vertical, product category, region, partner network or market from an early stage will be highly valued.



  





**Product / Sector Exposure** 




 The ideal candidate should have exposure to one or more of the following:
 


* **Balanced energy recovery ventilation systems (ERV/ HRV, fresh air)**
* **Residential ventilation systems**
* Heat recovery / energy recovery
* Indoor air quality solutions
* Air filtration / clean\-air solutions
* Premium HVAC systems
* Green building / energy\-efficient building solutions



  





**What We Are Looking For** 




 We are looking for a commercially strong, self\-driven professional with a builder mindset. The right candidate will be someone who has the maturity of working with international companies, but also the agility, ownership, and entrepreneurial drive required to build a business in a new market.
 



  





**Key Competencies** 




 ▪ Strong business development and pipeline creation capability
 



 ▪ Ability to build markets, channels, and partnerships from the ground up
 



 ▪ Commercially sharp and opportunity\-driven
 



 ▪ Strong network in HVAC / ventilation / building technology ecosystem
 



 ▪ Good understanding of specification\-led and project\-led sales
 



 ▪ Ability to work independently with limited local infrastructure
 



 ▪ High ownership, initiative, and accountability
 



 ▪ Strong communication and stakeholder management skills
 



 ▪ Comfortable working with international leadership teams
 



 ▪ Strategic thinking with hands\-on execution capability
 



  





**Why This Role Is Exciting** 




 ▪ Opportunity to lead the India market entry for a respected European brand
 



 ▪ First commercial leadership role for Zehnder in India
 



 ▪ High ownership and visibility with global leadership
 



 ▪ Opportunity to shape market strategy, channel structure, and early business growth
 



 ▪ Ideal role for a professional who enjoys building, not just managing.

**About Us:** 




  






 We are B2B Travel Tech startup that is reshaping the way travel agents sell and deliver exceptional travel experiences worldwide. We enable travel agents to book flights, hotels \& holidays conveniently and we provide comprehensive end\-to\-end on\-ground travel services.

 • Arun Bagaria – Co\-founder, Product — Ex\-Cars24, TravelTriangle, TripFactory \| IIM Bangalore
 





 • Chirag Agrawal – Co\-founder, Business — Ex\-OYO, TravelTriangle \| IIM Ahmedabad, IIT Roorkee
 





 • Ashish Thapliyal – Co\-founder, Technology — Ex\-CTO Cars24 \| CTO FabFurnish \| Gaadi
 




  





**What do we value?** 




  




* **We are a team of believers.** 

 At the same time, we are constantly learning and growing. We are on an audacious mission and have a rock\-solid belief we can get there.
* **We dream big,** 

 yet we start small and start quickly. We are not deterred by the extra effort needed to relentlessly execute, iterate, and execute to realise our dreams.
* **We are a team of differentiated and ambitious individuals** 

 , united by a common goal. We are a single team, where every member is important.
* **We believe flexibility in** 

 roles and freedom to execute ideas are the two foundational values for aggressive growth.
* **We constantly protect and** 

 evolve our culture. As a super energetic and experienced team, we want to enjoy the time we spend together.



**Our philosophy is simple :** 

 when travel agents grow, we grow with them.
 




  





**Your Mission** 




  






 Build and strengthen TravClan’s international DMC network so that our travel partners receive competitive rates, reliable service and strong on\-ground support. Own DMC sourcing, contracting, commercial performance and escalations end\-to\-end.
 




  





**Roles \& Responsibilities\-** 




  






 • Own the MICE strategy and P\&L, including GMV, revenue, contribution margin, collections and cash\-flow targets.
 





 • Build a strong pipeline across corporates, travel partners, incentive houses, conferences, offsites and large group movements.
 





 • Lead strategic opportunities end\-to\-end—from prospecting and RFP management through solutioning, negotiation, contracting and closure.
 





 • Build and grow key accounts through senior relationships, repeat business, cross\-selling and increased share of wallet.
 





 • Build and lead the MICE sales team; define targets and drive productivity through structured pipeline and conversion reviews.
 





 • Work with Quotes, Contracting, Operations and Finance to develop competitive proposals, protect margins and ensure accurate handovers.
 





 • Maintain reliable forecasts and MIS while using market and competitor insight to identify new growth opportunities.
 




  





**What is on Offer ?** 




  




* Ownership of a strategically important growth vertical.
* Direct founder and senior\-leadership interaction.
* Autonomy to shape the team, sales strategy and go\-to\-market model.
* Competitive compensation of about 18\-35 LPA (80% fixed and 20% variable)



  





**Growth Path:** 




  




* GM/Director \- 35\-50 LPA
* Head \- 18\-35 LPA
* Manager \- 10\-18 LPA
* Associate \- 5\-10 LPA



  





**Desired Candidate Profile** 




  






 • 5\+ years of experience in MICE sales, corporate travel, events or group travel, including meaningful business leadership.
 





 • Proven ownership of substantial revenue and profitability targets.
 





 • Strong record of acquiring and growing large corporate or partner accounts.
 





 • Established relationships across the corporate and MICE ecosystem.
 





 • Experience closing large domestic and international MICE opportunities.
 





 • Strong command of RFPs, contracting, pricing, margins, payment terms and collections.
 





 • Experience building and leading a high\-performance sales team.
 




  





**You will Thrive in This Role If....** 




  






 • You enjoy hunting for new business and owning ambitious targets.
 





 • You build senior relationships while maintaining sales discipline.
 





 • You balance growth with profitability, cash flow and delivery feasibility.
 




  





**This Role May not be the Right Fit if you.** 




  






 • Your experience is primarily in MICE operations rather than sales.
 





 • You depend mainly on inbound leads or inherited accounts.
 





 • You focus on topline without understanding margins or execution risk..

description:
**About Winfra Buildtech Pvt Ltd** 




 Winfra Buildtech Pvt Ltd is a leading manufacturer of high\-quality Zincalume storage tanks, offering customized and durable storage solutions for industrial, commercial, and residential applications. With a strong focus on innovation, quality, and customer satisfaction, the company delivers end\-to\-end storage solutions including manufacturing, installation, and maintenance services.
 



  





  





**Job Summary** 




 We are looking for an experienced and result\-driven
 **Production \& Planning Manager** 
 to oversee production operations, production planning, inventory coordination, manpower utilization, and dispatch scheduling. The candidate will be responsible for ensuring timely production execution, maintaining quality standards, optimizing resources, and improving overall operational efficiency.
 



 The ideal candidate should possess strong leadership skills, planning expertise, and experience in manufacturing operations.
 



  





  





**Key Roles \& Responsibilities** 




**Production Management** 



* Plan, manage, and monitor daily production activities to achieve production targets.
* Ensure smooth functioning of manufacturing operations with optimum utilization of manpower, machines, and materials.
* Monitor production schedules and ensure timely completion of orders.
* Coordinate with fabrication, assembly, dispatch, and installation teams for seamless operations.
* Ensure adherence to quality and safety standards during production activities.



**Production Planning \& Control** 



* Prepare monthly, weekly, and daily production plans based on sales orders and project requirements.
* Monitor production progress and take corrective actions to avoid delays.
* Coordinate with procurement and stores departments for timely material availability.
* Optimize production processes to improve productivity and reduce wastage.



**Inventory \& Material Management** 



* Monitor raw material consumption and stock levels.
* Coordinate with stores and procurement teams for inventory planning.
* Ensure proper control over material movement and production records.



**Quality \& Process Improvement** 



* Ensure production activities comply with quality standards and company procedures.
* Identify process improvement opportunities to enhance efficiency and reduce production costs.
* Implement SOPs and production control systems.



**Team Management** 



* Lead and supervise production staff, supervisors, and workers.
* Ensure proper manpower planning and shift management.
* Conduct regular performance monitoring and team coordination meetings.



**Reporting \& Coordination** 



* Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly production MIS reports.
* Coordinate with management regarding production status, delays, and operational requirements.
* Maintain proper production documentation and reporting systems.



**Safety \& Compliance** 



* Ensure workplace safety standards and compliance with company policies.
* Monitor machine maintenance schedules and operational safety practices.

**About The Role**
 What if your business expertise and leadership skills could directly shape how AI understands commerce, finance, strategy, and operations? We're looking for experienced Business Performance Analysts to lead and mentor a team of analysts creating high\-quality, business\-focused content that trains the next generation of AI models.
   

  

 This is a fully remote, flexible contract role ideal for someone who thrives at the intersection of people management, analytical rigour, and subject matter expertise. No prior AI experience required — your business background is what matters.
   

  

* Organization: Alignerr
* Type: Hourly Contract
* Location: Remote
* Commitment: 10–40 hours/week


**What You'll Do**
* Lead and mentor a team of Business Analysts and Content Specialists producing business\-domain content for AI training
* Allocate tasks, manage workflows, and ensure timely delivery of high\-quality outputs
* Conduct quality assurance reviews and continuously refine team processes for greater efficiency
* Provide constructive performance feedback, hands\-on coaching, and ongoing team development
* Serve as the primary point of contact for project stakeholders, delivering regular progress updates
* Guide the creation of case studies, business scenarios, and structured analytical content across domains including finance, policy, e\-commerce, and operations


**Who You Are**
* Experienced team leader with a strong track record of managing and developing analysts or specialists
* Deep practitioner in business analysis, consulting, or a related domain — you know your subject inside out
* Sharp analytical thinker who can evaluate the quality, logic, and accuracy of business content
* Clear, confident communicator who can translate complex ideas into structured, actionable feedback
* Self\-directed and organised — you manage priorities well and deliver without hand\-holding
* Creative and lateral thinker who can approach business problems from multiple angles
* No prior AI or tech experience required


**Requirements**
* Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Accounting, Economics, Statistics, or a related field — or equivalent professional experience
* 2\+ years of direct team management experience
* 3–6 years of experience in business analysis, management consulting, content strategy, or domain\-focused project work
* Strong research, analytical, and critical evaluation skills
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills


**Nice to Have**
* Master's degree or MBA in a relevant business or quantitative discipline
* Experience with data annotation, content evaluation, or quality assurance systems
* Background in case study writing, academic content, or structured business research
* Familiarity with AI tools or large language model workflows as an end user


**Why Join Us**
* Work on cutting\-edge AI projects alongside leading research labs
* Fully remote and flexible — work when and where it suits you
* Freelance autonomy with the structure of meaningful, leadership\-level work
* Gain rare, hands\-on exposure to how advanced AI models are trained and evaluated
* Contribute to work that shapes how AI reasons about business, finance, and strategy at scale
* Potential for ongoing work and contract extension as new projects launch

description:
**Join a Team That’s Passionate About Making Lives Better!**
 At Bill Gosling Outsourcing, we believe that success starts with an amazing team. We are a global leader in outsourcing solutions, we focus on making lives better, one connection at a time. We provide tailored solutions to businesses around the globe, specializing in customer care, sales, and financial services. We’re looking for enthusiastic, driven individuals to join our dynamic work environment where
 *fun meets results* 
 !
   

  

 Bill Gosling Outsourcing Corp.The Assistant Manager – Business Insights will assist in leading and managing projects aimed at improving business processes and systems. This role involves working closely with different departments to analyze current processes, identify areas for improvement, and develop and implement solutions that enhance efficiency, quality, and customer satisfaction.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Opportunity identification on the ground: Continuously scan the operations to surface improvement avenues, inefficiencies, and performance gaps, and maintain a prioritized pipeline of opportunities backed by data and operational evidence.
* Problem framing: Partner with the account team and functional owners to convert vague asks and observed pain points into sharp, scoped problem statements with clear business impact and decision needs.
* Diagnostics \& root\-cause analysis: Run structured deep dives using data analysis, process walkthroughs, floor observation, segmentation, and Lean Six Sigma methods to move from symptoms to underlying drivers.
* Analysis \& optimization: Build and maintain the analysis that drives decisions on the account — performance trends, driver analysis, and scenario comparisons — and translate findings into concrete optimization actions.
* Data \& analytical quality: Validate data availability, definitions, and reliability; reconcile conflicting sources; document assumptions and limitations; and assure the accuracy and reproducibility of analytical outputs.
* Solution enablement \& implementation support: Shape practical recommendations and support their implementation on the ground — coordinating owners, timelines, and dependencies so improvements are actually executed.
* Commercial \& account insight: Connect findings to account economics — productivity, cost\-to\-serve, SLA/KPI exposure, quality, and client\-impact implications.
* Technology \& process enablement: Identify where recurring problems can be addressed through dashboards, trackers, automation, or process redesign; define clear requirements and partner with development resources on delivery.
* Adoption \& impact tracking: Establish baselines, track adoption and action closure, and measure before/after business impact so improvements stick and benefits are evidenced.
* Reporting \& decision support: Translate analysis into concise, decision\-ready narratives and flags for account reviews and for the Assistant Manager / Manager, Business Insights.

title: Growth Manager - Enterprise Growth (Digital Commerce)
description:
**Company Overview** 




  





 GobbleCube is an agentic growth operating system designed to help brands scale profitably across digital marketplaces. Founded in November 2022 by the ex\- core team of Blinkit, the platform went live commercially from private beta in September 2024\.
 



  





 Since then, GobbleCube has scaled rapidly, supporting 600\+ brands across enterprise and D2C, growing revenue 10X, and onboarding 45 of India’s largest CPG enterprises in just the last 9 months, including HUL, Nivea, Tata Consumer Products, ITC, Godrej, Beiersdorf, MTR, L’Oréal, Hershey’s, and many more.
 



  





 As commerce becomes more distributed and hyperlocal, GobbleCube is building agentic solutions to help brands navigate complexity in real time, across visibility, performance marketing, supply chain, and growth strategy. Headquartered in Gurugram, the company supports brands across India, MENA, and LATAM.
 



  





**About the role** 




 India's largest CPG brands do business worth hundreds of crores every year on Quick Commerce platforms. They lose share for reasons invisible from a 360 dashboard: a dark\-store availability gap, a competitor outbidding them on a category keyword, a discount ladder that buys volume at the cost of contribution margin.
 



 GobbleCube finds those reasons. Your job is to walk into the brand's boardroom, tell the CXO what is happening, recommend what to do about it, and get a room of senior people who might disagree to commit to a decision.
 



  





**What this role is not** 




 This is not a marketing growth role. No funnel, no CAC, no acquisition budget, and no performance campaigns to run. If you are a growth marketer, this isn't the job you want.
 



 This is also not a traditional Customer Success role. You are not measured on tickets closed, QBR decks delivered, or logins. Nobody here will ask you to "drive adoption."
 



 The closest analogue is what an MBB consultant does for a CPG client, except you do it under a productised strategic consulting environment, for India's largest CPG brands at once, with a product doing the work in the background.
 



  





**What you will actually do** 



* Run regular strategic connects (online and in\-person both) with each account's senior leadership. Not a status update. A point of view on their business, and recommendations backed by data, to drive their business objectives.
* Diagnose why an output metric moved: market share, offtake, margin, etc. Decompose it into availability, visibility, discounting and supply chain. Then decide what is worth acting on.
* Take a difficult position to a senior stakeholder and make it land. Frequently the recommendation is "stop doing the thing that makes your number this month."
* Build the quarterly impact story: problem identified, action recommended, outcome achieved, revenue or share impact, in the brand's own numbers.
* Find the next business problem worth solving, prove it in a pilot, and convert it into expansion revenue.
* Turn what worked on one account into a repeatable SOP or a product requirement, so the ninth account does not need a ninth person.



  





**Who you will be in the room with** 




 CMOs, Sales Heads, E\-commerce Heads, Supply Chain Heads, occasionally CFOs. They are senior, have limited face time, and each of them wants something different from the same budget. Their KAMs and brand managers are your day\-to\-day.
 



  





**What makes this different from consulting** 




 The dogwork is automated. RCA, data pulls, anomaly detection, competitive tracking, and most of the analysis run through the product and agentic workflows in the backend. You are deciding what the analysis means, what to recommend (the right action at the right time), and how to get it approved. That is also the bar. When the analysis is free, the analysis is not the value. Your judgement is.
 



  





**How you will be measured** 



* Net revenue retention across your portfolio. Zero downsell, plus expansion.
* A documented, quantified impact story per account per quarter.
* Pilot\-to\-conversion rate on expansion modules.
* Qualified expansion opportunities briefed to GTM with a written business case.
* No account goes Amber without you flagging it first.
* Strategic connect coverage and conversation quality across your book.



  





**You will do well here if** 



* You can hold your position when a senior stakeholder tells you your data is wrong, without either backing down or repeating "the data says so."
* You are comfortable being the least senior person in the room and still owning the recommendation.
* You end conversations with an owner, a decision, a metric and a review date, rather than with an action\-items list.
* You would rather be right in eight weeks than agreeable today.



  





**You will struggle here if** 



* You need a clean brief before you can start.
* You want analysis to be your main contribution.
* Confrontation with senior stakeholders drains you.



  





**Requirements** 



* Bachelor's or Master's from a Tier 1 institute (IIT, IIM, ISB and equivalent).
* 3\-7 years in management consulting, strategy and ops, growth, or enterprise customer success at a B2B SaaS company. Consumer or retail exposure is a strong plus.
* Structured problem\-solving you can demonstrate live, not just describe.
* Presentation and stakeholder management skills at CXO level.
* Strong Excel. Enough SQL to interrogate an analysis and find the hole in it.

**Job Title**
 Project Engineer
   

  

**Job Description Summary**
 This role is responsible for leading end\-to\-end project planning and controls, from baseline development through monitoring and close\-out, ensuring alignment with project scope, schedules, budgets, resource plans, and statutory requirements.
   

  

**Job Description**
**About the Role:**
* Serve as the central coordination point for all finishing activities, ensuring alignment between clients, consultants, contractors, and internal teams to deliver high\-quality finishes in accordance with approved designs, project schedules, and quality standards.
* Lead the development of the project baseline, including scope breakdown, work sequencing, schedule preparation, cost planning, and resource loading—to establish a robust execution roadmap.
* Coordinate with multidisciplinary teams to ensure all design, procurement, and construction activities are accurately reflected in integrated project schedules and aligned with project objectives.
* Conduct regular Planning Review Meetings to track schedule performance, monitor critical paths, assess variances, and ensure timely incorporation of approved changes.


**General Responsibilities**
* Evaluate project schedules, work programs, resource plans, and cost estimates for feasibility, constructability, and compliance with contractual and statutory requirements.
* Monitor project progress using earned value metrics, dashboards, and MIS tools to identify delays, risks, and deviations from the baseline, and recommend corrective actions.
* Support procurement planning by tracking long\-lead items, vendor timelines, and material delivery schedules to ensure seamless construction sequencing.
* Conduct periodic site visits to validate reported progress, assess productivity, identify bottlenecks, and synchronize site execution with approved schedules.
* Prepare and maintain planning documentation—including baseline schedules, look\-ahead programs, progress reports, S\-curves, recovery schedules, and risk registers—to support informed decision\-making and project governance.


**About You**
* Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering
* 6\-8 years of experience in project management for large\-scale, Commercial projects within a PMC, developer, or consulting environment.
* Strong understanding of project planning, cost control, contract administration, construction methodologies, and regulatory compliance.
* Proficiency in project management software, scheduling tools (MSP/Primavera), and MIS/reporting systems.
* Excellent leadership, communication, problem\-solving, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to drive teams toward timely and quality project delivery.

 We are looking for an experienced Supply Chain Management \& Admin Head who can lead end\-to\-end supply chain, procurement, vendor management, logistics, inventory, and administration operations.
 



 The ideal candidate will have strong experience in the Drone/UAV industry, sound knowledge of drone technology and components, and an established pool/network of reliable vendors and suppliers.
 



 Role Overview
 



 The Supply Chain Management \& Admin Head will be responsible for developing and managing a robust and cost\-effective supply chain for AVPL's drone\-related operations.
 



 The person will be expected to build, maintain, and leverage a strong vendor ecosystem, ensure timely availability of critical components, optimize procurement costs, and ensure smooth administrative and operational functioning.
 



 Key Responsibilities
 



 1\. Supply Chain \& Procurement
 



 • Lead the complete Supply Chain Management and Procurement function.
 



 • Develop and implement strategic sourcing and procurement plans.
 



 • Ensure timely procurement and availability of materials required for drone manufacturing and operations.
 



 • Manage the complete procurement cycle from requirement identification to vendor selection, negotiation, purchase, delivery, and quality coordination.
 



 • Develop alternate sourcing strategies for critical components to minimize supply\-chain risks.
 



 • Identify opportunities for cost reduction, localization, and process improvement.
 



 2\. Vendor Management \& Vendor Network
 



 • Build, develop, and maintain a strong and reliable vendor pool across India and international markets.
 



 • Leverage existing industry relationships to identify and onboard reliable suppliers quickly.
 



 • Develop vendors for drone components, electronics, mechanical parts, batteries, motors, sensors, flight controllers, frames, payloads, communication systems, and other relevant components.
 



 • Evaluate vendors based on quality, cost, capacity, lead time, reliability, and delivery performance.
 



 • Negotiate pricing, payment terms, credit periods, MOQ, lead times, and commercial agreements.
 



 • Maintain a strong database of approved and alternate vendors for critical materials.
 



 • Continuously identify new suppliers and develop alternate sources to avoid dependency on single vendors.
 



 • Monitor vendor performance and take corrective action where required.
 



 3\. Drone / UAV Industry Knowledge
 



 • Possess a good understanding of the Drone/UAV ecosystem and its supply chain.
 



 • Understand the basic functionality and sourcing requirements of major drone components.
 



 • Have knowledge of components such as:
 



 o Motors \& ESCs
 



 o Flight Controllers
 



 o GPS/GNSS
 



 o Batteries \& BMS
 



 o Propellers
 



 o Frames
 



 o Sensors
 



 o Communication/Telemetry systems
 



 o Cameras \& Payloads
 



 o Electronic and mechanical components
 



 • Work closely with R\&D, Engineering and Production teams to understand BOMs, specifications, component requirements, and sourcing alternatives.
 



 • Stay updated with developments in the drone industry, component suppliers, and emerging technologies.
 



 4\. Inventory \& Logistics Management
 



 • Establish effective inventory\-control systems for critical components and finished products.
 



 • Monitor stock levels, consumption, lead times, and reorder requirements.
 



 • Minimize excess inventory, dead stock, material wastage, and stock\-outs.
 



 • Oversee warehousing, transportation, dispatch, and logistics operations.
 



 • Ensure timely movement of materials between vendors, warehouses, manufacturing units, and project locations.
 



 5\. Administration \& Facility Management
 



 • Lead overall administration and facility\-management activities.
 



 • Manage office, warehouse, manufacturing/facility infrastructure, security, housekeeping, transportation, and other administrative services.
 



 • Manage administrative vendors and service providers.
 



 • Ensure smooth day\-to\-day functioning of facilities and operational locations.
 



 • Monitor administrative budgets and optimize operational expenses.
 



 • Ensure compliance with internal policies, safety standards, and applicable statutory requirements.
 



 6\. Team \& Stakeholder Management
 



 • Lead and develop the Supply Chain, Procurement, Stores, Logistics, and Administration teams.
 



 • Coordinate closely with R\&D, Production, Engineering, Finance, Projects, Sales, and Management.
 



 • Establish clear KPIs and performance metrics for procurement and supply\-chain teams.
 



 • Prepare and present MIS and management reports related to procurement, inventory, vendor performance, and logistics.
 



 Key Skills Required
 



 • Strategic Procurement \& Sourcing
 



 • Supply Chain Management
 



 • Strong Vendor Development
 



 • Established Vendor Network / Vendor Pool
 



 • Vendor Negotiation \& Commercial Management
 



 • Inventory \& Warehouse Management
 



 • Logistics Management
 



 • Material Planning
 



 • Cost Optimization
 



 • Vendor Performance Management
 



 • Team Leadership
 



 • Administration \& Facility Management
 



 • MIS \& Reporting
 



 • Strong stakeholder\-management and negotiation skills
 



 Ideal Candidate Profile
 



 The best\-fit candidate will:
 



 • Have 10\+ years of experience in Supply Chain, Procurement, Operations, or related functions.
 



 • Have strong hands\-on experience in the Drone/UAV industry.
 



 • Have a good understanding of drone technology, components, manufacturing, and the UAV ecosystem.
 



 • Bring an established and extensive vendor pool/network, particularly for drone components and technology products.
 



 • Have strong relationships with suppliers and the ability to quickly source critical components.
 



 • Have experience managing procurement for electronics, mechanical components, batteries, motors, sensors, and other high\-tech products.
 



 • Have experience working with manufacturing, R\&D, engineering, or technology\-driven organizations.
 



 • Demonstrate strong negotiation and cost\-optimization capabilities.
 



 • Have experience managing teams and multiple vendors simultaneously.
 



 • Be highly proactive, commercially aware, and capable of building a scalable supply\-chain ecosystem.
 



 Preferred Industry Background
 



 Priority 1: Drone / UAV / Unmanned Systems
 



 Priority 2: Aerospace / Defence / Robotics
 



 Priority 3: Electronics / EV / Automotive / Advanced Manufacturing / Engineering \& Technology
 



 Education
 



 Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Supply Chain Management, Operations, Business Administration, or a related field.
 



 MBA/PGDM in Supply Chain, Operations, Procurement, or related specialization will be an added advantage.
 



 Key Hiring Priority
 


* Drone Industry Experience \+ Drone Component Knowledge \+ Strong Existing Vendor Pool/Network \+ Strategic Procurement Expertise will be the key differentiators for this position.) is preferred.

 The Service In\-charge is responsible for managing the day\-to\-day operations of one or more assigned Service Centres, Branches or Business Delivery Offices (BDOs), ensuring safe, timely and cost\-effective movement of shipments while consistently delivering high standards of operational performance and customer service.
   

  

 Reporting to the Branch Operations Head, the role provides operational leadership across the assigned locations by driving service quality, shipment processing, pickup and delivery performance, workforce productivity, customer experience, operational compliance and financial controls. The incumbent works closely with internal stakeholders and external partners to ensure seamless execution of operations, adherence to organisational standards and continuous improvement in operational efficiency.
   

  

**Job Purpose:**
 To manage the end\-to\-end operations of assigned Service Centres, Branches or BDOs by ensuring operational excellence, service quality, workforce effectiveness, customer satisfaction and compliance with organisational policies, while achieving productivity, cost and business performance objectives.
   

  

**Key Roles \& Responsibilities:**
**Service Centre Operations Management**
* Lead the day\-to\-day operations of assigned Service Centres, Branches and BDOs to ensure safe, efficient and timely execution of operational activities.
* Ensure adherence to operational workflows, standard operating procedures (SOPs) and service quality standards.
* Monitor daily operational performance and ensure achievement of shipment processing and delivery commitments.
* Drive operational discipline and ensure seamless coordination across all operational activities.
* Ensure readiness of manpower, infrastructure and operational resources to support business requirements.


**Shipment Processing \& Distribution Management**
* Monitor inbound and outbound shipment processing, scanning, sorting, dispatch and reconciliation activities.
* Review shipment pre\-alerts and plan operational activities to ensure timely processing and deliveries.
* Ensure timely allocation of delivery sheets, handheld devices and operational resources.
* Monitor delivery performance and proactively minimise undelivered shipments, return\-to\-origin (RTO) cases and operational exceptions.
* Coordinate with Hub Operations, Origin locations and Customer Service teams to resolve shipment\-related issues.


**Customer Service \& Exception Management**
* Ensure timely resolution of operational exceptions impacting customer deliveries.
* Coordinate with Customer Service teams to provide prompt resolution of customer complaints and service issues.
* Monitor exception cases and ensure timely follow\-up with all stakeholders.
* Ensure accurate and timely status updates in operational systems.
* Drive service quality initiatives to enhance customer satisfaction and operational reliability.


**Workforce \& Resource Management**
* Lead, guide and support operational employees and outsourced workforce across assigned locations.
* Conduct regular operational briefings and allocate responsibilities to ensure effective execution.
* Ensure optimum deployment of manpower, delivery resources and operational equipment.
* Monitor employee attendance, productivity and operational discipline.
* Support capability development through coaching, on\-the\-job guidance and adherence to training programmes.


**Financial \& Administrative Controls**
* Ensure accurate reconciliation and accounting of Cash on Delivery (COD) collections, customer documents and operational records.
* Monitor branch operating expenses and ensure prudent utilisation of resources in line with approved budgets.
* Maintain accountability of operational assets including handheld devices, scanners, vehicles and other equipment.
* Ensure timely completion of branch administration, documentation, reporting and statutory records.
* Coordinate with Finance and other support functions to resolve operational and administrative issues.


**Safety \& Compliance**
* Ensure compliance with all organisational policies, operational SOPs and statutory regulations governing branch operations.
* Promote a culture of safety by ensuring adherence to security, road safety and workplace safety standards.
* Support periodic operational, security and quality audits and ensure timely closure of audit observations.
* Ensure proper handling of shipments, operational assets and customer consignments to minimise operational risks.
* Drive compliance with company initiatives related to ethics, governance and risk management.


**Operational Governance \& Performance Management**
* Monitor key operational performance indicators including service quality, productivity, shipment accuracy and delivery performance.
* Prepare and review operational MIS, productivity reports and performance dashboards for assigned locations.
* Identify operational bottlenecks and implement corrective actions to improve efficiency and service reliability.
* Coordinate with cross\-functional teams including Customer Service, Sales, Network Operations and Hub Operations to ensure seamless execution.
* Escalate operational risks, capacity constraints and service issues in a timely manner while driving sustainable solutions.


**Continuous Improvement**
* Identify opportunities to improve operational productivity, cost efficiency and service quality across assigned locations.
* Support implementation of process improvements, automation initiatives and operational best practices.

 Orion Conmerx Private Limited is a leading manufacturer of high\-quality handcrafted leather apparel, bags, and accessories for international luxury brands, operating in India since 1993\. The company is SA8000, ISO 14001, and SMETA certified, reflecting a strong commitment to ethical practices, environmental responsibility, and sustainable supply chains.  The Leather Production \& Sourcing Manager is a full\-time, on\-site role based in New Delhi. * Prior experience in leather manufacturing or fashion accessories production, ideally in a high\-volume or export\-oriented environment.

This role provides an opportunity to work closely with the core team, learn complete warehouse operations, and gradually take on larger responsibilities as the company grows. title: Category Manager
description:
**MERCHANDISING MANAGER \- HOME** 




 Function: Merchandising \| Location: New Delhi (Tulsi Farms) \| Reporting to: Chief Merchandising Officer
 



 Experience: 6\-9 years in Merchandising (minimum 3 years handling the Home category)
 



**Step Into the World of Nicobar** 




 Founded in 2016 by Simran Lal and Raul Rai,
 **Nicobar** 
 is a modern, mindful, design\-led lifestyle brand from India.
 



*“We wanted to create a new Indian sensibility that wasn’t necessarily Westernised.”* 




 We’re reimagining a contemporary Indian way of living, dressing, and looking at the world—rooted in culture, shaped by design, and guided by intention. At Nicobar, we believe in culture as much as commerce, and that how we build is just as important as what we build.
 



 Our studio is tucked away in Tulsi Farms, Chhatarpur, Delhi. Nestled among trees, seasonal gardens, a citrus grove, and our beloved dogs Nico \& Dot, we call it
 *“
 
 the Treehouse.
 
 ”* 
 It earned its name when our architect reworked the blueprint to protect every single tree on the land. It’s a space where creativity brims and energy flows.
 



 If you’re drawn to thoughtful design, a youthful and nourishing team culture, and the chance to grow a brand with heart—we’d love to hear from you.
 



**Follow our journey:** 

 Instagram
 
 \|
 
 LinkedIn
 
 \|
 
 Nicobar.com
 
 \|
 **Watch our Co\-founders, Raul \& Simran talking about Nicobar**




**Reach out to us through the below link \-** 
 📩
 **https://lnkd.in/gghFi5Yz**




**Your Role in the Story** 




 You are the commercial engine behind Nicobar’s Home category – owning the numbers, the range, and the results across tableware, drinkware, textiles, décor, and furniture. Reporting to the CMO, you sit at the intersection of data and intuition, analysing what is selling, anticipating what should, and working across planning, design, sourcing, and retail to keep the category commercially sharp season after season.
 



**Where You’ll Make Impact** 



* Own the commercial performance of Home – sell\-throughs, best and worst sellers, markdowns, and replenishment against seasonal targets.
* Drive the Home range plan with design and sourcing – balanced, seasonally relevant, and aligned to pricing architecture and occasion (everyday, entertaining, gifting, festive).
* Manage width, depth, and open\-to\-buy – balancing core replenishable lines against seasonal drops, and keeping inventory and stock cover healthy.
* Build the seasonal buy and forecast – size and phase orders by channel, set OTB by sub\-category, and manage in\-season re\-orders to protect margin.
* Own markdown, ageing, and terminal\-stock strategy – act early on slow sellers, plan exit routes, and keep provision and liquidation under control.
* Ensure on\-time launches across channels, flagging critical\-path risks early enough to course\-correct.
* Set pricing and margin architecture for the category – benchmark against competitors, protect intake and realised margins, and guide sourcing on cost targets.
* Partner with the design team on newness and hero products – translate commercial signals into clear briefs for gifting, festive, and collection drops.
* Shop the market and competitors – identify white spaces and bring sharp, well\-evidenced range recommendations.
* Drive category expansion – spot adjacent sub\-categories and gaps in tableware, textiles, décor, and gifting, and build the case to enter them.
* Partner with VM and retail so the Home story is told well in\-store and online, and build reports and dashboards that turn numbers into decisions.



**What You Bring Along** 



* 5–8 years in fashion, home, or lifestyle merchandising, with a minimum of 3 years handling the Home category.
* Very strong analytical ability, including proficient, hands\-on command of Excel / Google Sheets.
* Fluent with AI and digital tools, and quick to apply them – turning technology into sharper planning, cleaner communication, and building efficient dashboards and workflows.
* You understand what makes Home aesthetically and commercially different – sub\-categories with distinct end uses, buying rhythms and margin logic.
* Strong cross\-functional skills with design, sourcing, planning, VM, and retail, and disciplined follow\-through across multiple drops.



**The Nicobar Spark** 



* A natural problem\-solver – you break messy, ambiguous situations into clear parts, and you'd rather bring a solution than escalate a problem.
* Strong stakeholder management – you build trust quickly across design, sourcing, planning, and retail, and you know how to influence without authority.
* A clear communicator – you turn numbers into a story people can act on, whether you're in a leadership review or a design huddle.
* Calm under pressure – drops, deadlines, and last\-minute changes don't rattle you; you re\-prioritise and keep the critical path moving.
* Detail\-obsessed without losing the big picture – you sweat the SKU\-level numbers but never lose sight of the season and the brand.
* A builder, not just a doer – you leave behind better templates, cleaner reports, and sharper ways of working than you found.
* Genuinely collaborative – you share credit, ask good questions, and make the people around you better.
* Commercially curious – you keep asking "why" behind the numbers and "what next" for the category.

title: Manager, APAC Client Risk
description:
**Proceed with Pride** 
 is Bain’s client selection and acceptance process. Developed in partnership with our Industry and Capability Practice Areas, it helps ensure we can be proud of the work we take on. When concerns arise, Partners are encouraged to engage the Proceed with Pride team for guidance and discussion.
   

  

 The focus is nearly always on identifying the right mitigating actions to enable us to Proceed with Pride, although in some instances we will jointly decide not to proceed.
   

  

 Regional Risk Officers (RROs) have been appointed to lead Regional Risk teams to align Proceed with Pride more closely with our line leadership. RROs are experienced, independent Advisory Partners and report to our
 **Chief Risk Officer** 
 , who reports to the Board Risk Sub\-Committee.
   

  

 In this role, you will support the
 **Senior Manager, APAC Client Risk** 
 , and the
 **APAC RRO** 
 , helping to shape and execute the region’s approach to client selection and acceptance. You’ll be a key driver of strategic thinking and operational execution across risk efforts in the region.
   

  

**Why you’ll want to join**
* Work at the intersection of ethics, reputation, and real\-world events: Apply critical thinking to complex topics (e.g., geopolitics, regulatory scrutiny, sensitive sectors, AI), and support senior decision\-making on whether and how Bain engages with clients and different types of work, balancing ethical and reputational trade\-offs with integrity, while protecting Bain’s values and enabling responsible growth.
* Build a critical capability for Bain’s future: Proceed with Pride is a growing, evolving function – help shape how we manage emerging risk issues, expand our scope, and modernise how we operate at scale.
* Direct exposure to senior leadership: Collaborate with Partners, Office Heads, Practice leaders, Legal, and PR/Comms, and support engagements with EMEA’s Regional Managing Partner (RMP) and Bain’s Board Risk Sub\-Committee.
* Have fun! Proceed with Pride is global, yet close\-knit – be part of a collaborative and supportive team with a meaningful mission, a strong culture of camaraderie and plenty of opportunities for professional growth.


**Key tasks**
* APAC Client Selection and Acceptance Process – Lead and manage end\-to\-end risk assessments
* Monitor the APAC opportunity pipeline to identify ‘higher risk’ cases flagged by risk guidelines, including work in regulated and reputationally sensitive sectors (e.g., gambling, sensitive areas of healthcare).
* Confirm assessment requirements with Partners and facilitate in\-depth discussions on client context and strategy, reputational considerations, and risk trade\-offs.
* Conduct relevant research, frame key questions, and coordinate input from Legal, PR, and other internal experts.
* Summarise decisions and mitigation plans, monitor implementation, and evaluate outcomes to protect Bain’s reputation and enable responsible growth.
* Risk Awareness, Education \& Engagement – Build and sustain a culture of risk mindfulness
