title: Operations Manager – Air & Sea Freight Forwarding | Import & Export | End-to-End Operations
description:
JOB TITLE: Operations Manager – Freight Forwarding (Air \& Sea)
 



  





 LOCATION: Gurgaon
 



 EXPERIENCE: 7–12\+ Years
 



 INDUSTRY: Freight Forwarding / Logistics / International Freight
 



  





 POSITION OVERVIEW
 



  





 We are looking for an experienced Operations Manager who can independently manage the complete freight forwarding operations across Air Freight and Sea Freight – Import \& Export.
 



  





 The candidate must have strong hands\-on knowledge of end\-to\-end shipment operations, pricing, costing, carrier/vendor coordination, documentation, customs coordination, transportation, customer handling, team management and operational profitability.
 



  





 This is a senior operational role. The candidate should understand not only how to execute shipments but also what every shipment costs, how it should be priced, where the margin is made or lost, and how the complete operation is controlled from booking to final delivery and billing.
 



  





 KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
 



  





 1\. END\-TO\-END FREIGHT OPERATIONS
 



  





 • Manage complete Air and Sea Freight operations from booking to final delivery.
 



 • Handle Import and Export shipments.
 



 • Manage FCL and LCL shipments.
 



 • Coordinate with customers, airlines, shipping lines, NVOCCs, co\-loaders, overseas agents, CHAs, transporters, CFSs and warehouses.
 



 • Monitor shipment milestones and ensure timely movement.
 



 • Resolve operational issues and escalations proactively.
 



  





 2\. AIR FREIGHT OPERATIONS
 



  





 • Manage Air Import and Export shipments.
 



 • Airline booking and rate coordination.
 



 • Handle AWB, HAWB and MAWB.
 



 • Manage flight schedules, cut\-offs and cargo acceptance.
 



 • Handle pre\-alerts and documentation.
 



 • Track shipments and provide timely status updates.
 



 • Handle flight cancellations, rollovers, offloads, delays and re\-bookings.
 



 • Coordinate with airlines and handling agents.
 



  





 3\. SEA FREIGHT OPERATIONS
 



  





 • Manage Sea Import and Export operations.
 



 • Handle FCL and LCL shipments.
 



 • Coordinate with shipping lines, NVOCCs and co\-loaders.
 



 • Handle MBL and HBL.
 



 • Manage booking confirmation and vessel schedules.
 



 • Handle Shipping Instructions (SI) and VGM.
 



 • Coordinate container allocation, pickup, stuffing and gate\-in.
 



 • Check BL drafts and manage amendments.
 



 • Handle transshipment coordination.
 



 • Manage Arrival Notice, Delivery Order and final delivery.
 



 • Control detention, demurrage and free\-day issues.
 



  





 4\. PRICING, COSTING \& COMMERCIAL CONTROL
 



  





 • Understand Air Freight and Sea Freight buy and sell rates.
 



 • Obtain and negotiate rates with airlines, shipping lines, NVOCCs and vendors.
 



 • Calculate complete shipment costs before quoting.
 



 • Understand origin and destination charges.
 



 • Manage THC, CFS, documentation, handling, carting, transportation and other applicable charges.
 



 • Calculate selling price and expected gross margin.
 



 • Identify cost leakages and unnecessary expenses.
 



 • Coordinate with the sales/commercial team for accurate quotations.
 



 • Verify vendor invoices against agreed rates.
 



 • Ensure correct customer billing and recovery of operational charges.
 



  





 5\. CUSTOMS \& CLEARANCE COORDINATION
 



  





 • Coordinate with CHAs and customs clearance teams.
 



 • Understand the complete Import and Export customs process.
 



 • Working knowledge of Shipping Bill, Bill of Entry, ICEGATE, examination, assessment, LEO and OOC processes.
 



 • Resolve customs queries and documentation discrepancies.
 



 • Ensure timely customs clearance and delivery.
 



 • Monitor shipments under customs hold or examination.
 



  





 6\. DOCUMENTATION
 



  





 The candidate should have strong knowledge of:
 



  





 • Commercial Invoice
 



 • Packing List
 



 • AWB / HAWB / MAWB
 



 • HBL / MBL
 



 • Shipping Bill
 



 • Bill of Entry
 



 • Shipping Instructions
 



 • VGM
 



 • Certificate of Origin
 



 • Delivery Order
 



 • Arrival Notice
 



 • Pre\-alerts
 



 • Insurance and shipment\-specific documents
 



  





 7\. VENDOR \& CARRIER MANAGEMENT
 



  





 • Maintain strong relationships with airlines, shipping lines, NVOCCs, co\-loaders, transporters, CHAs, CFSs and warehouses.
 



 • Negotiate operational rates and service terms.
 



 • Monitor vendor performance.
 



 • Resolve rate disputes and service failures.
 



 • Ensure vendors work according to agreed commercial and operational terms.
 



  





 8\. TEAM MANAGEMENT
 



  





 • Lead and manage the Air and Sea Operations team.
 



 • Allocate shipments and responsibilities.
 



 • Monitor daily operational performance.
 



 • Establish and implement SOPs.
 



 • Train team members on operational procedures.
 



 • Coordinate between Operations, Sales, Documentation, Accounts and Customer Service.
 



 • Handle critical operational escalations.
 



  





 9\. CUSTOMER \& ESCALATION MANAGEMENT
 



  





 • Act as the senior operational point of contact for key customers.
 



 • Handle customer escalations related to delays, documentation, rates, clearance and delivery.
 



 • Provide accurate shipment updates.
 



 • Ensure service commitments are met.
 



 • Maintain strong customer relationships through reliable operational execution.
 



  





 10\. OPERATIONAL MIS \& CONTROL
 



  





 • Maintain shipment\-wise operational records.
 



 • Track shipment status and pending actions.
 



 • Monitor operational costs and revenue.
 



 • Track detention, demurrage and additional costs.
 



 • Review vendor bills and customer billing.
 



 • Prepare operational MIS and management reports.
 



 • Identify operational bottlenecks and implement corrective actions.
 



  





 MUST\-HAVE REQUIREMENTS
 



  





 • 7–12\+ years of experience in Freight Forwarding / International Logistics.
 



 • Strong hands\-on experience in Air and Sea Freight Operations.
 



 • Experience in both Import and Export.
 



 • Strong knowledge of FCL, LCL and Air Freight.
 



 • Strong understanding of freight rates, costing and margins.
 



 • Good knowledge of customs clearance and CHA coordination.
 



 • Strong documentation knowledge.
 



 • Experience dealing with airlines, shipping lines, NVOCCs and logistics vendors.
 



 • Strong vendor negotiation and management skills.
 



 • Experience managing an operations team.
 



 • Strong problem\-solving and escalation\-management skills.
 



 • Good understanding of the commercial and financial aspects of freight forwarding.
 



  





 CRITICAL REQUIREMENT
 



  





 The candidate must be capable of independently explaining a complete Air Export and Sea Import shipment process from booking to final delivery, including:
 



  





 • Operational process
 



 • Documentation
 



 • Parties involved
 



 • Freight and local charges
 



 • Vendor coordination
 



 • Customs process
 



 • Potential operational problems
 



 • Customer billing
 



 • Cost calculation
 



 • Margin calculation
 



  




* The candidate must have practical, end\-to\-end Freight Forwarding knowledge and should be capable of independently taking ownership of the complete Air \& Sea Operations function.

description:
**Manager – Exports, Imports \& Global Commercial Operations** 




 End\-to\-end ownership of the international order\-to\-delivery cycle
 



  





**Company:** 
 APAC Sourcing Solutions Limited \| www.apacss.com
 



**Location:** 
 Gurgaon
 



**Experience:** 
 10 – 20 Years
 



**Industry:** 
 Chemicals / Specialty Chemicals / Ingredients / International Trading / Merchant Export / Global Sourcing
 



**Function:** 
 Export \& Import Operations / International Logistics / Supply Chain / Commercial Operations
 



 Employment Type: Full Time
 



  





**About the Company** 




 APAC Sourcing Solutions Limited is engaged in Global Sourcing, Merchant Export, Custom Manufacturing and Product Development — sourcing products from India and other Asian countries for customers across the USA, Canada, Europe and other international markets. Our business spans chemicals, pharmaceuticals, APIs, pharmaceutical intermediates, food and cosmetic ingredients, natural products, polymers, specialty 
 



 chemicals and custom\-manufactured products.
 



 We are looking for an experienced professional to take end\-to\-end ownership of international export execution. This is a high\-responsibility position and is not limited to routine export documentation or logistics coordination.
 



  





**Role Objective** 




 The incumbent will own the complete order\-to\-delivery cycle:
 



***Customer Order → Supplier Confirmation → Production / Material Readiness → Shipment Planning → Freight Negotiation → Container / Isotank Booking → Export Documentation → Customs → Vessel Departure → Shipment Tracking → Customer Communication → Delivery***




 The principal objective is to ensure that APAC consistently delivers the
 **right product, right quantity and right documentation, at the right freight cost, and within the customer’s committed ETA.** 




  





**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** 




**1\. End\-to\-End Export Order Ownership** 




 ● Take ownership of every confirmed international customer order.
 



 ● Establish a detailed execution plan from order confirmation to delivery.
 



 ● Track production, material readiness, shipment booking, documentation, customs, vessel departure and ETA.
 



 ● Maintain a live order and shipment tracker.
 



 ● Identify risks well in advance and initiate corrective action.
 



**2\. Customer ETA Management** 




 ● Work towards 100% adherence to committed customer ETA.
 



 ● Monitor vessel schedules, transit times, supplier readiness and shipment milestones.
 



 ● Identify potential delays before they affect the customer.
 



 ● Develop alternative logistics plans where necessary.
 



 ● Maintain clear visibility of customer\-required ETA versus actual / revised ETA.
 



**3\. Supplier / Manufacturer Coordination** 




*A critical part of the position — the incumbent is expected to actively drive supplier readiness rather than wait for supplier updates.* 




 ● Coordinate continuously with suppliers / manufacturers across India and Asia.
 



 ● Confirm production schedules and firm up material readiness dates; follow up on production progress.
 



 ● Coordinate QC / testing and COA availability; confirm packaging and dispatch readiness.
 



 ● Ensure material is ready sufficiently before vessel cut\-offs; coordinate pickup / loading.
 



 ● Identify and escalate supplier delays at an early stage.
 



 ● Ensure suppliers understand customer delivery commitments.
 



 4\. Freight Negotiation \& Cost Optimisation
 



 ● Obtain competitive ocean freight quotations and benchmark rates across major trade lanes.
 



 ● Negotiate with shipping lines, carriers, NVOCCs and logistics providers.
 



 ● Analyse freight components and surcharges; monitor PSS, GRI and other freight changes.
 



 ● Develop direct relationships with shipping\-line commercial teams.
 



 ● Identify opportunities for cost reduction and minimise unnecessary intermediary costs.
 



 ● Maintain freight\-rate records and benchmarks.
 



**5\. Direct Shipping\-Line Booking** 




 Where commercially feasible, develop APAC’s capability to book containers and isotanks directly with shipping lines / carriers, covering:
 



 Direct carrier relationship development • Vessel schedule identification • Rate negotiation • Space booking • Container / isotank availability • Booking confirmation • Equipment release • SI / VGM cut\-off management • Gate\-in coordination • Vessel rollover management • Carrier escalation
 



*Experience with isotank shipments and DG cargo will be an advantage.* 




**6\. Customer Communication \& Shipment Visibility** 




 Maintain proactive communication with international customers, providing timely updates on:
 



 Supplier / material readiness • QC / COA status • Expected dispatch • Container / isotank booking • Vessel details • ETD • Port status • Transshipment • Shipment movement • ETA • Any changes or delays • Shipping documents.
 



*The fundamental principle is: NO SURPRISES FOR THE CUSTOMER.* 




 If an ETA is at risk, the customer must be informed proactively along with the reason, revised timeline and corrective action.
 



**7\. Export Documentation** 




 Coordinate preparation and verification of:
 



 Commercial Invoice • Packing List • Certificate of Origin • COA • SDS / MSDS • DG Declaration • Shipping Instructions • VGM • Shipping Bill • Bill of Lading • Customer\-specific documentation • Product / regulatory documents as applicable
 



*Ensure documentation is accurate and completed before applicable cut\-offs.* 




**8\. Customs \& ICEGATE – In\-House Capability** 




 A key objective for APAC is to develop stronger in\-house control over export customs processes. The incumbent will manage direct preparation and filing of Shipping Bills through the ICEGATE portal, wherever applicable:
 



 ● Prepare Shipping Bill data; verify HSN / ITC classification and export details.
 



 ● File Shipping Bills through ICEGATE and monitor filing status.
 



 ● Resolve validation errors / queries and coordinate with Customs.
 



 ● Monitor the process through clearance / LEO and relevant post\-export stages; maintain proper records.
 



 ● Ensure timely filing so customs formalities do not affect vessel cut\-offs or customer ETA.
 



*APAC will continue to use CHA / C\&F agents primarily for physical customs, port and related activities requiring their involvement, while building greater in\-house capability for documentation, electronic filing, tracking and export execution.* 




**9\. CHA / C\&F / Port Coordination** 




 ● Coordinate with CHA / C\&F agents for customs and port activities; ensure timely customs clearance.
 



 ● Monitor Shipping Bill status and LEO; coordinate examination / inspection where required.
 



 ● Ensure containers reach port within cut\-off; resolve customs / port\-related issues promptly.
 



 ● Monitor DG\-related requirements where applicable.
 



**10\. Container \& Isotank Planning** 




 ● Plan container and isotank requirements in advance; ensure equipment availability before material readiness.
 



 ● Coordinate loading and dispatch; monitor equipment release and return requirements.
 



 ● Coordinate DG and special\-handling requirements; avoid last\-minute equipment shortages.
 



**11\. Shipment Risk \& Exception Management** 




 Proactively manage supplier / production / quality\-release delays, container and isotank shortages, vessel cancellations and rollovers, port congestion, customs issues, documentation errors, DG acceptance issues, transshipment delays and freight increases.
 



*Expected approach: Identify → Analyse → Act → Communicate → Resolve → Close* 




**12\. Management Reporting** 




 Maintain an updated shipment dashboard covering:
 



 Customer • PO • Product • Quantity • Supplier • Production status • Material readiness • QC / COA • Container / isotank • Booking • Vessel • ETD • Customer ETA • Current ETA • ETA variance • Documentation • Customs • Gate\-in • Risk status • Next action
 



  





**KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS** 




 The position will be measured primarily on outcomes:
 



 100% focus on committed customer ETA • Supplier readiness against agreed dates • On\-time shipment execution • Competitive freight rates \& direct carrier bookings • Container / isotank availability • Timely and accurate documentation • Timely ICEGATE Shipping Bill filing • Zero avoidable documentation\-related shipment delays • Proactive customer communication \& early risk identification • Reduction in emergency 
 



 freight and avoidable demurrage / detention • 100% visibility of active shipments
 



  





**CANDIDATE PROFILE** 




 10 – 20 years in export operations / international logistics / supply chain • Chemicals, pharmaceuticals, specialty chemicals or ingredients experience preferred • Strong knowledge of export documentation \& Indian export procedures • Container shipments experience; DG preferred; isotank an advantage • Strong freight negotiation \& direct dealings with shipping lines • Supplier / manufacturer coordination \& 
 



 strong customer communication • ICEGATE / Shipping Bill filing highly desirable; strong Excel / ERP / CRM • Able to manage multiple international shipments simultaneously
 



  





**Personal Attributes** 




 Strong ownership • Commercial orientation • Excellent follow\-through • High sense of urgency • Proactive communication • Strong negotiation skills • Problem\-solving ability • Attention to detail • Works independently • Manages pressure \& multiple priorities
 



  





***The mindset we are looking for: “Once APAC accepts a customer order, I own the execution until the shipment reaches the customer within the committed ETA.”***




 If you want to build and own an international export operation rather than merely process documents, this is an excellent opportunity to make an impact.
 



  





**HOW TO APPLY** 




 Mail your resume to aloksrivastava@apacss.com and odes@apacss.com APAC Sourcing Solutions Limited \| Gurgaon \| www.apacss.com

The D. E. Shaw group is a global investment and technology development firm with more than $100 billion in investment capital as of June 1, 2026, and offices in North America, Europe, and Asia. Since our founding in 1988, our firm has earned an international reputation for successful investing based on innovation, careful risk management, and the quality and depth of our staff. We have a significant presence in the world’s capital markets, investing in a wide range of companies and financial instruments in both developed and developing economies.
   

  

 We are looking for a highly resourceful, proactive, and detail\-oriented individual to join our Operations and Client Services team supporting D. E. Shaw Investment Management (DESIM), our institutional asset management group, based out of Hyderabad and Gurugram, India. DESIM was established in 2005 and currently has over $19\.1 billion in assets under management. DESIM builds on the experience and infrastructure of the broader firm to develop and manage active investment strategies that complement the firm’s alternative investment strategies. The group currently operates a platform of systematic, active equity strategies and a platform of discretionary, multi\-asset class strategies. This position offers the opportunity to contribute to an inclusive team at ground level and to work with senior leaders at the firm while assuming considerable responsibility.
   

  

**WHAT YOU'LL DO DAY\-TO\-DAY:**
 You will be a part of a team that is responsible for designing and implementing processes and controls to support a growing business, executing strategic projects and initiatives, and optimizing internal and external client service. You will provide operational support for fund and managed account launches and liquidations, complex investor transactions, and investment mandate changes. Additionally, you will engage with internal stakeholders on operational matters, working closely with the team on initiatives aimed at improving client service while interacting directly with investors and counterparties. You will contribute to the reporting function within the team, supporting the production of investor reports, managing day\-to\-day reporting workflows, and coordinating production. Furthermore, you will participate in changing management processes, working closely with the DESIM COO and other internal stakeholders on projects and initiatives aimed at creating automated and efficient processes, along with supporting technology projects to build tools for reporting and analysis, streamlining workflows, and improving the user experience. You will have the opportunity to gain a macro view of the firm’s financial activities and learn about complex legal entity structures and transactions while enjoying substantial interaction with other internal departments, including technical investing groups, corporate development, investor relations, legal and compliance, and software development groups.
   

  

**WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR:**
 The ideal candidate should hold\-
   

  

 Basic qualifications:
   

  

* A Chartered Accountancy qualification or a master’s degree in finance, along with 2–6 years of experience in fund operations and/or client service roles within the financial services sector
* Proficient project management and critical thinking skills with good commercial judgment
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to build rapport and collaborate effectively with stakeholders at all levels of the organization
* Exceptional problem\-solving abilities, a process\-oriented mindset, the ability to execute short\-term tasks while contributing to long\-term projects, and the desire to work as part of a team. Additionally, excellent attention to detail and a proactive approach to work are essential
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office, including Excel


 Preferred qualifications:
   

  

* Knowledge of investor transactions, brokerage/counterparty relationships, and hedge fund accounting functions
* Prior experience in mentoring or coordinating small teams and a track record of contributing to process improvements
* Demonstrated ability to identify and implement scalable automation, AI solutions, and agentic workflows that streamline reporting and improve operational efficiency


 Interested candidates can apply through our website: https://www.deshawindia.com/recruit/jobs/Ads/Link/SrAnaMgrDESIMOCSAug26
   

  

 We encourage candidates with relevant experience looking to restart their careers after a break to apply for this position. Learn about Recommence, our gender\-neutral return\-to\-work initiative.
   

  

 The Firm offers excellent benefits, a casual, collegial working environment, and an attractive compensation package. For further information about our recruitment process, including how applicant data will be processed, please visit https://www.deshawindia.com/careers
   

  

 Members of the D. E. Shaw group do not discriminate in employment matters on the basis of sex, race, colour, caste, creed, religion, pregnancy, national origin, age, military service eligibility, veteran status, sexual orientation, marital status, disability, or any other protected class.

title: Site IT Operations

1. the success of engagement(s)

**How you’ll grow**

 At Deloitte, you are encouraged to take ownership of your career. title: On-site Technology Support ITAM Lead
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**On\-site Technology Support ITAM Lead (Associate Director)**
**Enterprise Technology (ET)**
 Enterprise Technology provides reliable, secure, and resilient technology services and solutions to support over 300,000 EY people. As part of Enterprise Technology, you’ll be at the forefront of enabling innovative technologies including emerging collaboration tools and world\-class technology infrastructure.
   

  

 Our aim is to build an outstanding customer experience with clear investment in innovation, alongside operational excellence that delivers efficient, quality services and solutions. You will work with technologists and business specialists to meet the increasing pace of our business. That means more growth for you, exciting learning opportunities, career choices, and the chance to make a real impact.
   

  

**The opportunity**
 As part of Enterprise Technology, the On\-site Technology Support’s mission is to help our customers fulfil their purposes and contribute to building a better working world by providing a fit for purpose support service.
   

  

 The On\-site Technology Support \- Information Technology Asset Management (ITAM) leader will be responsible for enterprise IT hardware asset management for all Global Delivery Service (GDS) centres globally. The leader will manage the entire IT asset lifecycle including planning, acquiring, deploying, managing, auditing, and retiring for end user asset library (Notebooks, Desktops, Mac, Printers, Audio / Visual equipment, Monitors, Peripherals, Consumables etc..). The person will manage the IT asset management portfolio with respect to business performance, risk, cost, and legal compliance. This position requires strategic thinking, strong financial acumen, passion for process excellence, strong business partnership and vendor management skills. Driving change, consolidation and service improvement is a key aspect of this role whilst keeping their team motivated in a highly changing, dynamic, diverse, and cross\-cultural environment.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Re\-imagine the next generation ITAM delivery model. Develop and maintain a roadmap and strategy for end\-to\-end IT asset lifecycle management including planning, sourcing, forecasting, capacity management, demand \& supply, delivery, disposal, and e\-waste management.
* Mature the ITAM program and create automated and sustainable ITAM operations, enhance and automate, by reducing manual efforts. Propose, plan, and partner with cross\-functional teams to deliver system automation as per firms’ strategy.
* Interface and collaborate directly with Finance, Procurement, Talent, Legal, Sourcing, Business Operations, and Compliance teams to ensure effectiveness of ITAM program.
* Responsible for ensuring quality control throughout the lifecycle of all entity IT assets by developing and implementing appropriate procedures to track and manage them.
* Listen to the voice of the customer and own KPI metrics related to ITAM. Take appropriate action to drive satisfaction and operational excellence.
* Identify opportunities and develop plans for ongoing improvement across IT Asset Management, Configuration Management Database (CMDB) including optimize, re\-harvest, and/or repurpose unused or partially used IT assets, to achieve full efficiency and ROI from company resources.
* Govern and manage Fixed Asset Register (FAR) reconciliation, annual audit compliance, SEZ, regulatory, and customs related process.
* Plan and execute hardware refresh / upgrade programs and ensure availability of minimum inventory of different specifications all locations as per business demand.
* Serve as the single point of contact for all ITAM related contracts and sponsor for IT Asset Management vendor engagements.
* Oversee vendor reseller and OEM engagements to meet established service level targets and key performance indicators.
* Be the face of IT Asset Management to all Business Partners and Executive Leadership. Engage, create, and collaborate on solutions based on business demands.
* Participate in steering committee meeting representing ITAM strategy for Global Delivery Centres.
* Manage and develop IT Asset Lifecycle Management policies, standards, and procedures as per Global ITAM standards and their associated business value.
* Act as a coach to team to deliver scope, meet schedules, balance workload, and resolve roadblocks. Escalate timely to ensure programs and/or services are not jeopardized.
* Establish a service culture with sufficiently ITIL\-educated operations management and staff. Establish and administer the annual budgets and manage expenditures to operate within the approved budget.
* Maintain a high\-level understanding of the business objectives, processes and supporting
* Technology needs of all customers in the Region. Stay sensitive to unique local needs.
* Work with leadership to optimize the business value, quality, and cost of requested services to meet the Firm and EY Technology objectives and policies with a clear articulation of the service levels delivered.
* Collect viewpoints on Technology needs and service issues and communicate these to the appropriate EY Technology leader.
* This role is required to physically work in an EY office.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Ability to define the organization’s asset management \& inventory policy based on industry best practices.
* Demonstrated experience in financial management including budgeting, sourcing, and service costing.
* Understanding of technology and data visualization skills—artificial intelligence, machine learning, Internet of Things, analytics software, and apps.
* Ability to develop \& comprehend the data visualization reports to track orders and shipments, trends, demand and any weaknesses and inefficiencies based on different parameters.
* Advanced analytical skills are required to identify opportunities for service and process improvement across the geography supported.
* Comprehend market economics and dynamics. Predict possible future scenarios by gaining insights into the market trends.
* Work independently with limited oversight from a supervisor.
* High\-level decision\-making responsibilities include the prioritization of work for the IT Asset
* Management function and determining approaches to effectively address service delivery concerns of large customer base.
* Demonstrated ability to manage effectively with escalations, difficult situations and demanding individuals under pressure.
* Co\-ordinate, understand and successfully integrate the activities of a large cross\-cultural, cross\-border team including virtual interaction and ability to travel as per requirement.
* Demonstrated ability to manage all aspects of team management including hiring, development, and counselling.
* High level understanding of SEZ, regulatory, customs, compliance protocols relevant to the role.


**To qualify for the role, you must have**
* 15\+ years of applicable work experience in large multi\-country teams.
* BE\-IT, B.Tech, Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Information Technology.
* Certification in ITIL \& IT Asset Management preferred
* 5\+ years’ experience of working directly in IT Asset Management role or experience in supply chain management preferred.
* Established experience in vendor relationship management, outsourcing strategy, and e\-waste management.
* Proven track record in leading positive team dynamics that drives efficiencies in throughput.
* Strong organizational, analytic, and complex problem\-solving skills
* Highly effective speaking, listening, writing, project management and interpersonal skills
* Effective communications and collaborative skills with ability to work with management, business and technical leaders and staff of all levels.
* Experience with IT service management tools and/or knowledge of major ITAM products such as Service Now or equivalent.
* Successful candidate will be an energetic passionate leader who demonstrates initiative, and the ability to generate creative solutions and deliver with excellence.
* Exceptional customer service orientation. Work schedule flexibility to adjust to multiple demands, shifting priorities, ambiguity, and rapid change


**What We Offer**
 As part of this role, you'll work in a highly integrated, globally diverse team with the opportunity and tools to grow, develop and drive your career forward. Here, you can combine global opportunity with flexible working. The EY benefits package goes above and beyond too, focusing on your physical, emotional, financial and social well\-being. Your recruiter can talk to you about the benefits available in your country. Here’s a snapshot of what we offer:
   

  

**Continuous learning** 
 : You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next. Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a significant impact, your way.
   

  

**Transformative leadership:** 
 We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
   

  

**Diverse and inclusive culture:** 
 You’ll be accepted for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.
   

  

 We ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided with reasonable accommodations to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodations.
   

  

**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Engineering Manager (Chemical Engineer)
description:
**Job Purpose**
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
 People Leader, accountable for providing leadership for Process Engineers within the Engineering \& Process Technology group through creating shared vision \& values, developing and utilising talent and driving performance. Leads and directs programs with the objective to enhance engineering productivity and efficiency.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Principal accountabilities**
**Leadership**
 Manage EHS through management of change, behavioural safety and ensuring a safe work environment and compliant with Business and Group operating standards, procedures and systems.
   

  

 Drive results through aligning the team with business strategy and goals, establishing clear standards of engineering excellence, and setting clear direction and accountabilities through performance management whilst providing balanced feedback at the most critical times to maintain momentum and a strong sense of ownership.
   

  

 Act as a change agent, lead, support and contribute to change programmes, driving and championing the implementation, gaining acceptance to enable an agile and engaged team.
   

  

 Feed into workforce plans to ensure the right resourcing requirements for current and future business needs. This includes understanding current and future capability needs and addressing those through development interventions.
   

  

 Lead succession planning to ensure a strong talent pipeline and to mitigate critical skills gaps.
   

  

 Inspire growth through career conversations, developing talent and ensuring the team has the skills and experiences to deliver, develop and progress careers within JM \- Honeywell.
   

  

 Ensure all team members have up to date Personal Development Plans, which are reviewed on a regular basis and provide input into training planning to ensure team members have access to relevant and appropriate training opportunities.
   

  

 Provide input to Engineering resource planning to ensure developmental objectives are known and addressed.
   

  

 Support team development and ensure team are appropriately aligned to the technical career path based on their capability and business need. Provide input to the Grade Review Process.
   

  

 Responsible for allocating resource to basic engineering/development projects according to business demands.
   

  

 Instil trust and value differences, generating confidence and safety with others through openness and authenticity, modelling high standards of honesty, transparency and integrity whilst promoting a team environment that values, encourages, and supports differences.
   

  

 Develop employee engagement strategy for the team to motivate and drive engagement.
   

  

 Facilitate collaboration with shared values for engineering to partner across teams and functions to create high performing teams to achieve common goals.
   

  

 Provide input and recommendations on reward and benefits processes for team e.g. annual review.
   

  

 Carry out people and business processes within HR and Business systems (e.g. Workday process initiation, leave \& expense approvals, etc).
   

  

 In conjunction with other Engineering Managers, establish and maintain engineering capability across CT’s offices.
   

  

**Execution \& Delivery (Program Management)**
 Maintain and enhance the capabilities and productivity within the Engineering \& Process Technology function.
   

  

 Initiate and lead major transformation projects to scale and grow engineering capacity and capability for the organization.
   

  

 Deputise for the Engineering Management Director, as required.
   

  

 Drive L\&D/training requirements and transition into an Engineering Academy.
   

  

* Monitor and assess the training requirements of new starters and current engineering staff.
+ Developing training programs to address training needs.
+ Identify training themes to address and initiate the preparation and presentation of courses with the objective of building a library of training material (recorded presentation, how\-to guides, interactive training tools, etc) that support the engineering functions.
+ Identify internal and external training providers working alongside Learning and Development.


 Recruitment / Onboarding
   

  

* Responsible for recruitment of permanent and contingent engineering staff. Manage relationships with engineering service providers.
+ Work with the Talent Acquisition team to develop recruitment campaigns to attract new hires.
+ Set the standard for competencies and capabilities required for new hires, and methodology for assessment.
+ Review CVs, interview candidates and recommend outcomes.


 Engineering Tasks
   

  

* Approve BEP engineering documentation as required.
+ Approve basic engineering package execution strategy and engineering hour estimation.
+ Ensure procedures are reviewed and updated as required.
+ Identify and prepare new procedures/guidance as required by Engineering.
+ Identify improvements to Engineering tools and methodologies, implementing improvement programs as required.
+ Support Lead Engineers in project execution.


 To take on any other duties which are within the employee’s skills and abilities whenever reasonably instructed.
   

  

**Scope**
 Primary interactions are within CT E\&PT Leadership team and CT’s engineering service providers.
   

  

 Planning horizon 1\-3 months tactical, 3\-36 months for S\&OP process resourcing, 5 years for strategic engineering footprint.
   

  

 People leadership \& development.
   

  

**Special factors**
 Geography global.
   

  

 Up to 25% international and domestic travel on average can be expected.
   

  

 Flex work patterns to accommodate working across different time zones, when required.
   

  

**Qualifications**
**Person specification**
 This describes what is required to do the job, it may not describe the current job holder but should describe the typical attributes or traits needed for success in the position.
   

  

**Qualifications/ Knowledge/ Experience**
 Degree in Chemical Engineering or equivalent experience
   

  

 Understanding of technology development, engineering and licencing
   

  

 Member of a recognised Professional Institution
   

  

**About Us**
 Honeywell Technologies is a global, pure\-play automation company with a legacy of innovating to help solve the world’s most mission\-critical challenges, enhancing the quality of life for people and communities around the world. We serve the building, industrial and process sectors with a broad portfolio of services, solutions and products, underpinned by our Honeywell Technologies Accelerator operating system and Honeywell Technologies Forge intelligence layer. By combining the deep domain expertise of our more than 50,000 employees with decades of data from our global installed base, we are uniquely positioned to lead the industrial sector’s transition from automation to autonomy.

**About the job** 
 Google's line of products and services to our clients never stops growing. The Partnerships Development team is responsible for seeking and exploring new opportunities with Google's partners. Equipped with your business acumen and extensive product knowledge, you are right on the front line of interacting with our partners, and helping them find ways to grow using Google's newest product offerings. Your knowledge of relevant verticals and relationships with key industry players will help shape our great applications and content for products such as YouTube, Google TV and Commerce.
   

  

 Debug ( debug.com ), a Google initiative to reduce mosquito\-borne diseases, has spent over a decade developing end\-to\-end technologies to help protect the 4 billion people worldwide at risk of dengue. By integrating custom software, hardware automation, scientific innovation, and AI, Debug delivers both mosquito suppression and replacement solutions at scale. At the core of this approach is Wolbachia, a naturally occurring bacterium that serves as a precise, chemical\-free way to stop mosquitoes from spreading diseases.
   

  

 As the Partnerships Manager for India, you will be the entrepreneurial driver establishing Debug’s footprint from the ground up. You will navigate complex regulatory pathways, architect technology licensing partnerships, and bridge global engineering with local operational deployment to reduce mosquito\-borne disease. The Global Partnerships organization is responsible for exploring new opportunities with Google's partners. Google’s Global Partnerships team works with a wide range of partners to bring the best of Google to power their business. The Global Partnerships team supports Google’s own Product teams with essential partnerships to help Google’s user experiences in advertising, Search, Assistant, Maps, Travel, Shopping, Payments and more. Teams create product\-enabling partnerships, go\-to\-market strategies and incubate business growth for a variety of products.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Drive debug’s effort in India to develop and execute go\-to\-market strategy and partnerships that can establish debug as a trusted vector\-control solution.
* Lead the agreement sourcing and execution including origination, evaluation, developing market strategies, and negotiating complex technology licensing agreements and commercial agreements with local operational partners, private enterprises, and public health entities.
* Structure and negotiate operational models with partners by working with internal science and program manager teams to formulate field requirements with technical capabilities and program timelines.
* Evaluate opportunities, conduct due diligence, negotiating agreement terms, and working with cross\-functional teams to prepare and present recommendations to senior leadership. Ensure the consistent exercise of appropriate judgment and discretion in matters of significance.
* Identify, establish, and grow relationships with existing and new partners. Act as the central point of contact and maintain comprehensive account knowledge.

 The Manager, Quality – Digital Systems is a business\-facing role that serves as the primary point of contact between RQA’s digital quality systems and the stakeholders who depend on them, with working technical depth in Veeva eQMS administration and GxP\-regulated system operations anchoring that work. This role is accountable for the reliable administration and continuous improvement of Veeva eQMS processes, including access management, business administration, release coordination, and reporting. The successful candidate will bring enough configuration fluency \- understanding vault object relationships, shared versus instance\-specific configuration, and the downstream consequences of proposed system changes \- to translate technical trade\-offs into clear guidance for stakeholders and support faster, better\-informed decisions on enhancement requests and system design questions.
   

  

 The successful candidate must communicate clearly across technical and business audiences, understand stakeholder needs, assess business and technical trade\-offs, and support technology decisions that advance quality operations and broader business objectives. Beyond day\-to\-day operations, this role independently represents the RQA Digital Systems team within cross\-functional programs and enterprise initiatives, scoping RQA’s responsibilities within a given program and developing and driving the execution plan on behalf of the team. This role operates with a high degree of autonomy, maintaining clear situational awareness across assigned responsibilities and bringing issues and decisions forward proactively.
   

  

 This position requires strong communication and analytical skills, working Veeva domain knowledge, genuine curiosity about applying AI and emerging technology to quality operations, and the ability to operate effectively in a regulated pharmaceutical environment — both as a business partner and as an accountable owner of complex, cross\-functional work.

* Develop, prepare, and deliver reporting across functional areas.


**eQMS Systems Expertise \& Advisory**
* Provide guidance on Veeva vault configuration options in support of business needs, including object relationships, shared configuration dependencies, and the downstream impact of proposed changes, partnering with technical teams to fill configuration depth as needed.
* Support the triage and formulation of eQMS enhancement requests, providing business context and impact assessment alongside stakeholder needs and operational impacts to inform prioritization and decision\-making.

**Cross\-Functional Program Support**
* Independently represent the RQA Digital Systems team within enterprise programs and initiatives requiring digital systems support, scoping team responsibilities, developing execution plans, and delivering against them.
* Maintain clear ownership of workstream status and decisions; proactively surface blockers or escalation points to leadership.
* Coordinate with Pfizer Digital and cross\-functional teams to support enterprise quality data integrity and system continuity efforts.


**Reporting \& Data Operations**
* Issue clear and timely communications, ensuring stakeholders are informed and aligned on timelines and expected outcomes.
* Execute periodic data extracts and reporting tasks, including basic dashboarding and data queries, in support of regulatory and quality operations, ensuring accuracy, timeliness, and appropriate documentation.
* Develop and maintain operational documentation and user guidance for current and legacy quality systems to ensure operational continuity.
* Gather, synthesize, and prepare materials for stakeholder communications and leadership briefings, translating system and data insights into accessible formats.


**Transformation \& Continuous Improvement**
* Proactively identify opportunities for meaningful process improvement and digital transformation within RQA’s quality systems operations, bringing both technical grounding and operational context to proposed solutions.
* Apply practical AI knowledge to evaluate use cases, partner with technical teams, and drive adoption of AI\-enabled solutions.
* Contribute to and support broader organizational transformation initiatives, including AI integration into quality workflows, eQMS process redesign, and platform evolution.
* Stay current on Veeva platform capabilities, GxP digital systems trends, and regulatory expectations, applying emerging best practices to improve the team’s operations and delivery.


**QUALIFICATIONS:**
* Bachelor’s degree in Life Sciences, Information Systems, Computer Science or a related field with 5\+ years of relevant industry experience; advanced degree preferred.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills; able to produce clear documentation, user\-facing guidance, and stakeholder\-ready reports.
* Demonstrated experience working directly and iteratively with business stakeholders to understand their underlying needs and workflows.
* Working knowledge of Veeva Vault eQMS or a comparable enterprise quality/GxP system, including working knowledge of vault object relationships and configuration dependencies.
* Demonstrated, hands\-on curiosity about AI\-enabled tools, automation, or advanced analytics, with concrete examples of applying them to improve processes and drive innovation.
* Experience in a GxP\-regulated pharmaceutical or biotech environment with demonstrated understanding of quality management system processes.
* Proven ability to operate autonomously and collaboratively on complex, cross\-functional work.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills; able to assess the downstream impact of system changes and translate business needs into actionable decisions.


**Preferred:**

title: Administration
description:
**About the Role** 




 The Administration personnel will be responsible for overseeing and managing the overall administrative and facility operations of FICCI. The role will ensure efficient functioning of office infrastructure, facilities, vendors, security, logistics and administrative services while maintaining high standards of service, compliance and cost effectiveness.

**Key Responsibilities:** 




**1\. Administration \& Facility Management** 



* Oversee day\-to\-day administrative operations and ensure smooth functioning of FICCI offices and facilities.
* Manage office infrastructure, housekeeping, maintenance, utilities, seating arrangements and workplace services.
* Ensure timely resolution of administrative and facility\-related issues.
* Develop and implement administrative processes, SOPs and service standards.
* Ensure appropriate upkeep and maintenance of office assets and infrastructure.



**2\. Vendor \& Contract Management** 



* Identify, evaluate and manage external vendors and service providers.
* Negotiate commercial terms, service agreements and contracts with vendors.
* Monitor vendor performance and ensure adherence to agreed service levels.
* Manage contracts related to housekeeping, security, maintenance, transportation, facility management and other administrative services.
* Ensure cost\-effective procurement of administrative services in coordination with the concerned teams.



**3\. Security \& Safety** 



* Oversee security arrangements across FICCI premises.
* Coordinate with security agencies and ensure appropriate deployment and monitoring of security personnel.
* Ensure implementation of workplace safety, emergency preparedness and access\-control procedures.
* Coordinate emergency response and crisis\-management arrangements as required.



**4\. Events \& Conference Support** 



* Provide administrative and logistical support for conferences, meetings, exhibitions, delegations and other FICCI events.
* Coordinate venue arrangements, seating, transportation, hospitality, security and other logistical requirements.
* Work closely with internal departments and external agencies to ensure smooth execution of events.
* Support arrangements for visits by senior government officials, industry leaders, international delegations and other VIP guests.



**5\. Travel \& Logistics** 



* Oversee administrative arrangements related to official travel, transportation and accommodation, wherever applicable.
* Coordinate transportation and logistical requirements for senior management, delegates and official programmes.
* Ensure timely arrangements for meetings, visits and official engagements.



**6\. Asset \& Inventory Management** 



* Oversee management and maintenance of office assets, equipment and administrative inventory.
* Maintain appropriate records of assets and ensure periodic verification.
* Coordinate repair, replacement and disposal of assets as per organisational policies.
* Ensure adequate availability of office supplies and other administrative requirements.



**7\. Government \& External Coordination** 



* Coordinate with relevant government authorities, local administration, civic bodies and external agencies on matters relating to facilities, permissions, security, events and other administrative requirements.
* Manage external stakeholder relationships relevant to administrative operations.



**8\. Budget \& Cost Management** 



* Prepare and monitor the annual administrative budget.
* Track administrative expenditure and identify opportunities for cost optimisation.
* Review vendor bills and service\-related expenses in coordination with Finance.
* Ensure administrative activities are undertaken within approved budgets and organisational guidelines.



**9\. Team Management** 



* Lead, supervise and develop the administration team.
* Define responsibilities and performance expectations for team members.
* Ensure effective coordination between administration, security, housekeeping, maintenance and other support functions.
* Build a service\-oriented and responsive administrative team.



**Key Skills \& Competencies:** 



* Strong administrative and facilities management expertise.
* Excellent vendor and contract management skills.
* Strong negotiation and cost\-management capabilities.
* Excellent organisational and operational planning skills.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
* Ability to manage large\-scale events and complex logistics.
* Strong problem\-solving and decision\-making abilities.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment.
* Proficiency in MS Office and administrative management systems.
* High level of integrity, ownership and accountability.



  





**Education:** 




 Graduate degree in any discipline. MBA/PGDM or a relevant qualification in Facilities/Administration Management will be an advantage.
 



**Experience:** 



* Prior experience in managing large office facilities and administrative operations.
* Experience in vendor management, contracts, budgeting and team leadership.
* Experience in managing high\-level events, conferences and VIP/government delegations will be an advantage.



**Desired Attributes:** 



* Mature and professional approach with strong leadership capabilities.
* Ability to interact effectively with senior management and external stakeholders.
* Strong ownership and execution orientation.
* Excellent attention to detail.
* Ability to anticipate operational requirements and proactively resolve issues.
* Strong service orientation and ability to maintain confidentiality.
* Comfortable working beyond routine office hours when required for major events or organisational requirements.

title: Medical Coder Manager
description:
**Company Description** 
 OnSure Health LLC specializes in end\-to\-end Revenue Cycle Management, supporting healthcare organizations with efficient financial and operational workflows. The company leverages technology, AI, and automation to develop solutions that simplify processes across coding, accounts receivable (AR), and denials management. OnSure Health LLC also provides front staffing solutions, medical scribe services, IT consulting, and bad debt collection support. Team members collaborate to optimize clinical documentation, streamline billing, and enhance overall practice performance for healthcare clients.
   

**Role Description** 
 The Medical Coder Manager is a full\-time, on\-site role based in New Delhi, responsible for overseeing the medical coding team and ensuring accurate, compliant coding practices. This role includes reviewing and validating coded records, monitoring coding quality, and implementing standards that align with regulatory and payer requirements. The Medical Coder Manager will manage day\-to\-day workflow, assign and prioritize coding tasks, and collaborate closely with revenue cycle, AR, and denials teams to reduce rejections and optimize reimbursements. Additional responsibilities include training and mentoring coders, maintaining up\-to\-date knowledge of coding guidelines and payer policies, and preparing regular reports on coding performance and productivity. The individual will also work with leadership and IT teams to support process improvements and automation initiatives that enhance coding efficiency.
   

**Qualifications**
  

* Demonstrated coding experience and proficiency in Medical Coding across multiple specialties.
* Strong foundation in Medical Terminology and Health Information Management principles.
* Relevant certification such as RHIT or equivalent credential in health information or coding.
* Experience managing or leading a coding team, with proven ability to supervise workflows and quality.
* Knowledge of payer rules, compliance standards, and current coding guidelines (ICD, CPT, HCPCS).
* Excellent analytical, problem\-solving, and documentation review skills.
* Effective communication skills and ability to collaborate with clinical, billing, and IT teams.
* Proficiency with coding and billing software, EHR systems, and reporting tools.
* Bachelor’s degree or diploma in Health Information Management, Healthcare Administration, or a related field preferred.

description:
HEAD – SALES

 CEO / Business Leadership
   

  

**About EdTerra**

 **Head – Sales**

 **business leadership role** 
 with end\-to\-end ownership of the sales engine—from market strategy and school acquisition to key account growth, sales\-team performance, forecasting and revenue delivery.

* Translate business targets into territory, segment, product and team\-level targets.
* Identify new revenue opportunities across geographies, school segments and products.
* Drive both new business acquisition and growth of existing accounts.
* Develop strategies to increase customer lifetime value, repeat business and wallet share.

* Build a predictable and scalable sales process from lead generation → qualification → meetings → proposals → negotiation → closure → repeat business.

* Maintain strong visibility on pipeline value, probability and expected closures.
* Develop accurate revenue projections based on historical performance and current pipeline.
* Use sales data to identify trends, risks and opportunities.
* Present actionable sales insights and recommendations to the leadership team.
* Develop territory\-wise and account\-wise performance dashboards.

* Identify and evaluate new cities, regions and school segments for expansion.
* Analyse competitor positioning, pricing, offerings and market trends.
* Develop go\-to\-market strategies for new products and markets.
* Identify emerging opportunities within the education and experiential\-learning ecosystem.
* Work with the leadership team to evaluate strategic partnerships and new business channels.
* Key Account Growth \& Retention
* Build a structured Key Account Management framework.
* Develop annual growth plans for strategic schools.
* Drive repeat journeys, renewals and increased engagement with existing schools.
* Monitor account health, satisfaction and revenue potential.
* Ensure high\-value clients receive proactive relationship management.
* Work with Operations and Customer Experience teams to resolve critical client concerns.
* Commercial \& Margin Ownership
* Balance revenue growth with profitability and contribution margins.
* Participate in pricing and commercial strategy.
* Establish appropriate discounting and negotiation frameworks.
* Monitor deal economics and commercial effectiveness.
* Work closely with Finance to improve collection efficiency and reduce outstanding receivables.
* Ensure sales commitments remain commercially and operationally viable.

* Operations – delivery feasibility and execution

 Ensure seamless alignment between
 **what is sold, what is promised and what is delivered** 
 .

* Deliver agreed annual revenue and growth targets.
* Build a predictable and healthy sales pipeline.
* Improve sales conversion and sales productivity.
* Strengthen the key\-school account portfolio.
* Increase repeat business and customer retention.
* Build a high\-performing and accountable sales leadership team.
* Improve forecast accuracy.
* Establish standardized sales processes and performance dashboards.
* Identify and successfully penetrate new markets.

* Pipeline Health
* Closure Predictability


**People**
* Team Target Achievement
* Sales Attrition
* Manager Productivity
* Internal Talent Development


 Candidate ProfileExperience
   

  

* 10–15\+ years of progressive experience in B2B / institutional / consultative sales.
* 4\+ years in a senior sales leadership role managing sizeable sales teams.
* Proven experience owning significant revenue targets.
* Experience managing multi\-city or multi\-region sales operations preferred.
* Strong experience in relationship\-led businesses such as education, EdTech, travel, hospitality, SaaS, media or other B2B services will be advantageous.


 Education
   

  

* Bachelor's degree in any relevant discipline.

 Core Competencies
   

  

* Strategic Sales Leadership
* Revenue \& P\&L Orientation
* B2B / Institutional Sales

* Negotiation \& Commercial Acumen
* Sales Forecasting
* CRM \& Sales Analytics
* Market Expansion

* Coaching \& Performance Management

* Builds strong, long\-term relationships.
* Can challenge existing processes and create better systems.
* Develops people rather than simply managing them.

leading

**About Agoda**
 At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.
   

  

 Today, we are part of Booking Holdings \[NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.
   

  

 No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.
   

  

**Get to Know our Team:** 
  

  

 Agoda’s Customer Support Team understands that travel can be an everchanging environment. That is why we provide in\-person, real\-time help around the clock and in 38 languages. No matter the issue, we present the best of Agoda’s values to each customer with multiple support channels and a strong desire to serve. Certainly, doing more than answering phone calls or replying to emails, our specialists actively look for ways to improve our customer’s experience. We quickly adapt to challenges by collaborating with other teams and experimenting on everything we can. This has allowed us to develop new and effective products that produce meaningful results and continue to drive Agoda’s business performance. Our Customer Support Team serves a daily role in contributing to a core strength and service of Agoda with a clear vision and a focus on efficient and satisfying customer support.
   

  

 Are you a dynamic leader with a knack for driving success in a multicultural environment?
   

  

 This role is responsible for leading the customer service teams supporting English Languages as they provide support to customers across voice, email, chat, and back\-office activities.
   

  

 The Manager of Customer Experience Group provides vision, leadership, and guidance to each team leader and associates in the key operating areas through performance and goal setting. Effectively communicates with team, developing a climate in which information is shared openly. Clearly defines team goals and expectations. Develops tactical plans to reach these goals. This role requires a high level of personal and professional skills associated with running global operations teams. First and foremost, this is a people leader role and enabling local teams to be successful is core to the role. In addition to being a brilliant people leader and communicator, the ideal candidate will bring a vision, a sense of curiosity, a passion for travel, keen analytical skills, a tech\-centric mindset, and a willingness to lead by example.
   

  

 This position will report to the Head of Customer Service Delivery: English and is open to applicants based in India only.
   

  

**What You'll Do:**

* Understands the key drivers of customer satisfaction \& dissatisfaction and works with customer service leaders to address customer dissatisfaction and implement self\-healing processes where possible
* Regularly review customer feedback and QA insights to help educate teams about Agoda products and services as well as identify customer handling improvement opportunities
* Invests energy to inspire, coach, mentor, and develop emerging customer service leaders so we develop individuals as well as organizational resilience
* Raises the bar on talent through serving as faculty in internal learning programs, or helping inform development of new L\&D programs, or helping to attract credible external talent
* Creates a positive team culture, employee engagement where teams understand and live Agoda values, particularly around taking ownership and striving to be their best
* Ensures teams “get the right results, the right way”; goes beyond numerical team SLA achievement to build an ethical team culture


**What You'll Bring:**
* A minimum of 10 years of work experience, with at least 3 years in a senior role managing operational responsibilities (contact center, vendor management at scale, etc.).
* Excellent problem\-solving capabilities, with a knack for identifying process improvement opportunities using a data\-driven approach.
* The ability to successfully lead or support multiple initiatives concurrently.
* A proven track record of leading change.
* Persuasive skills to convince senior leaders.
* A fast\-paced approach to problem\-solving and decision\-making.
* The ability to foster a culture of personal development through coaching and partnership with L\&D, engagement, and continuous improvement.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English. Excellent personal and interpersonal skills to lead the team and partner effectively with other departments.
* E\-commerce or travel industry experience is a plus.

* Knowledge of PC applications / tech savvy
* Must be an assertive team player with high energy to work in fast\-paced environment
* Ability to work with very minimal guidance or supervision in a time critical environment.
* Strong time management skill.
* Must have a strong track record of evaluating, analyzing, implementing, leading, and monitoring effective and efficient processes to proactively improve center efficiency and staff performance.



 In addition, it will be great if you have:
   

  

* Certifications in Project Management – such as PMP, Six Sigma, COPC, or equivalent credentials

* New Country Expansion \& Process Migration – proven experience in launching operations in new countries or leading complex process migrations is a strong advantage

title: Operations - Treasury Operations - AVP (Payments & Security)
description:
**Company Overview**
 KKR is a leading global investment firm that offers alternative asset management as well as capital markets and insurance solutions. KKR aims to generate attractive investment returns by following a patient and disciplined investment approach, employing world\-class people, and supporting growth in its portfolio companies and communities. KKR sponsors investment funds that invest in private equity, credit and real assets and has strategic partners that manage hedge funds. KKR’s insurance subsidiaries offer retirement, life and reinsurance products under the management of Global Atlantic Financial Group. References to KKR’s investments may include the activities of its sponsored funds and insurance subsidiaries.
   

  

**Team Overview**
 The Global Treasury team manages liquidity, funding, and banking relationships across regions and business lines. The team partners closely with internal and external stakeholders to ensure financial control, operational efficiency, and compliance while driving automation, integration, and continuous improvement across the firm’s global treasury infrastructure.
   

  

**Position Summary**
 The role is responsible for overseeing the day\-to\-day activities performed by the team, hiring, training, and establishing priorities. This role provides frequent exposure to various business leaders and the opportunity to drive impactful changes.
   

  

* The Assistant Vice President will lead treasury vertical(s) supporting global teams, oversee end\-to\-end operational processes, and play a pivotal role in driving strategic transformation initiatives.
* This individual will manage a high\-performing team, lead key automation and system integration projects, and serve as a critical liaison across global Treasury, Finance, Operations, Technology, and external banking partners.
* The ideal candidate combines technical treasury expertise, project execution capability, and strong leadership and communication skills to influence outcomes across regions and functions.


**Roles \& Responsibilities**
* Leadership \& Team Management
* Lead treasury operations vertical(s), ensuring delivery excellence, control adherence, and high performance.
* Coach, mentor, and develop team members while fostering a collaborative, high\-accountability culture.
* Establish clear priorities, performance goals, and development plans aligned with global objectives.
* Strategic Projects \& Transformation
* Drive global treasury transformation initiatives including automation, process optimization, and system integrations.
* Partner with Technology and Operations teams to implement digital solutions improving efficiency, control, and scalability.
* Support global standardization of treasury processes and policies, embedding best practices across geographies.
* Treasury Operations \& Controls
* Own capital call and management fee reconciliation for private markets, including research and resolution of unidentified funds.
* Own FX reconciliation between counterparties and internal system and partnering with Technology to advance automation of this process.
* Own preparation of transfers between internal accounts and the capital call accounts.
* Maintain and reconcile cashbooks for funds on a monthly basis.
* Generate and maintain cash\-balance and transaction reports (including via Hazeltree), including the weekly APAC cash balance report and transaction/position reports configured to stakeholder requirements.
* Own preparation of credit wires and partnering with Technology and Operations to transition this workflow to straight\-through processing (STP).
* Oversee callback processes for funding beneficiaries and vendors across APAC, EMEA, and US regions.
* Review and certify funding beneficiaries on internal system.
* Overseeing and supporting third party admins operations as needed.
* Oversee maintenance of vendor banking details (including on behalf of Avega) in Coupa.
* Own audit requests related to PE funds reporting and FX reconciliation, ensuring timely and accurate responses.
* Stakeholder Management
* Partner with global Treasury leadership, leadership across functions, fund controllers, and technology teams to align on priorities and deliverables.
* Act as a key point of escalation for issues and ensure timely resolution.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with external banking partners and counterparties.
* Collaborate across regions (U.S., EMEA, APAC) to deliver consistent, high\-quality treasury services.


**Qualifications**
* Master’s degree in Finance, Accounting, or related discipline; professional certification (e.g., CTP, CFA, CA, CPA) preferred.
* 10–12 years of experience in treasury, cash management, or financial operations within a global financial institution or asset manager.
* Proven experience leading teams and managing global processes or projects.
* Strong understanding of treasury workflows, accounting principles, and risk control frameworks.
* Experience with treasury systems and tools such as S4Hana, Coupa, Workiva, Hazeltree, Smartsheet, and Excel is preferred, not mandatory.
* Demonstrated success driving automation, process transformation, or system integration
* Exceptional communication, stakeholder management, and influencing skills across senior leadership levels.
* Ability to work across time zones with a global mindset, balancing strategic priorities with operational rigor.
* High integrity, intellectual curiosity, and a proactive approach to problem\-solving.


**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS (Leadership Attributes)**
* Collaborative: Builds trust and alignment across teams and regions.
* Influential: Communicates with clarity and impact to drive decisions.

* Strategic \& Analytical: Balances execution detail with long\-term vision.
